# AuraCardea

把一轮对话里**与回答正文无关的中间态**按类折叠的浏览器 UI 插件。

名字取自罗马的门轴女神 **Cardea**：*cardo* 是铰链、枢轴（英文字 "cardinal" 同源），开与合
只是同一个铰链的两面——这正是插件在做的：把过程折起来，需要时展开。

它只接管 `conversation.chat.node` 里 `turn-process` 一个渲染位，不动任何内置插件、不改
DSH 安装产物；被折叠的行仍然挂载在 React 树里，靠一张按行 key 作用域的样式表隐藏。

## 效果

一轮结束后（或运行中）在轮次开头显示：

```
● 正在运行 mcp__gui__gui_shot · 27 次工具调用        ✓25  ✗1   ›
   › 思考 ×10
   › cordis_define ×5            ✓5
   › pwsh ×5                     ✓5                  Σ 7.5s
   › 上下文注入 ×5
   › mcp__gui__gui_find ×3       ✓2  ✗1  Error: {...}  Σ 11.5s
   › mcp__gui__gui_shot ×5       ✓4  正在运行          Σ 5.3s
```

- **按类聚合**：同名工具聚成一行（`×N`），思考、上下文注入、重试各自一类
- **统计**：每类 `✓成功 / ✗失败` + 失败摘要；`Σ` 是该类总耗时；汇总行给全轮合计
- **展开就地**：点类别 → 该类每次调用的条目直接列在下面（状态符、参数摘要、耗时），
  再点条目 → 完整参数 + 输出（超 4000 字符截断）
- **图片**：`read_image` 之类结果里的图片直接出缩略图，双击放大，点空白/双击图/✕ 关闭
- **失败原因聚合**：类别行汇总该类所有失败原因——全相同时写 `exit 1`；混合时写
  `exit 1×6, +1 种`（最多的那个 + 种类数），悬停该文本用 title 给出完整分解
  （`exit 1×6 / exit 2×2`）；条目行各自保留自己的 `exit 1` / `exit 2`
- **退出码**：shell 命令的失败是「结果数据」而不是 `isError`，所以另外从输出尾部读
  `[exit code: N]` / `[killed by signal: X]`：非零退出计入 ✗，并在条目上直接标
  `exit 2` / `signal SIGKILL`，类别行的失败摘要也用它
- **时序**：每条调用左侧带本地时钟 `22:44:12`（右边是耗时或「已运行 X」），类别行的 `Σ`
  悬停显示该类起止时间 `22:40:12 → 22:44:39`；按类聚合不会打乱时间——条目仍按时间升序
- **运行中动效**：类别行与条目行共用同一组三个「琴键」
  一轮，透明度 0.3→0.85），一眼看出在动，但扫读时不抢注意力；`prefers-reduced-motion`
  下退化为静态竖条
- **运行中高亮随时间加深**：「注意」而非「警告」——始终在同一品牌色相里加强度，不借用
  警告/错误色。左侧 2px 色条 + 底色，按已运行时长分三档：<2 分钟 蓝 12%/条 55%、
  2–10 分钟 蓝 18–20%/条 80%、>10 分钟 蓝 24–26%/条 95%（类别行按该类最老的
  在跑调用取档）；组件在有运行时每 15s 自刷一次，所以没有新事件时「已运行 5m16s」
  与强度也会自己前进
- **运行中底色**：正在跑的类别行与条目行都带浅蓝底色（圆角 5px），
  叠加原有的呼吸点与「正在运行」文字
- **运行中**：正在跑的那一类标「正在运行」；汇总行写「正在运行 X · N 次工具调用」，
  并行时写 `×N`；单个条目显示「已运行 2m14s」，结算后换成精确耗时

## 安装

AuraCardea 同时声明了 `dsh.bundle` 和 `dsh.client`：bundle 负责把行挂进 DSH，client 负责浏览器半。

> 当前 DSH 0.2.x 没有官方插件市场；`dsh.bundle` 让本包可以被任意配置的插件市场索引列出。

**方式 A（插件市场 / Discover）**：在「插件 → 发现」添加包含 `aura-cardea` 的索引源并安装；bundle 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会自动插入挂载行，不需要手改 patch。

**方式 B（命令行 + 手动挂载）**：`dsh plugin --profile web add aura-cardea`，然后按下面挂载。

挂在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 的末段：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: client-aura-cardea
      name: 'aura-cardea'
```

宿主半（`lib/index.js`）是空插件，唯一作用是让 Loader 有这一行可挂载——`dsh.client`
清单被发现后，浏览器半 `lib/client.js` 才会被登记进启动图并从 `/plugins` 提供。
浏览器模块 id 必须等于包名（`aura-cardea`）。

> 只对 DSH 0.2.x 的 web profile 有效；升级 DSH 后先跑 `check-kinds`。
> 如果从旧版绝对路径迁移，删掉旧的 `client-aura-cardea` 段，再按上面任一种方式挂载，不要同时保留两行。

## 关闭 / 回滚

- 临时关闭：在那一行加 `disable: true`，或者在插件页停用它
- 彻底移除：删掉 `insert` 段，重启 `dsh web`
- 回滚整份补丁：恢复 `cordis.patch.yml.bak-auracardea-<时间戳>`

## 依赖的 DOM 契约（改版时最需要先看这里）

| 契约 | 用途 | 缺失后果 |
|---|---|---|
| 座位外层 `data-chat-anchor-key` | 按行 key 隐藏被折叠的行 | 折叠失效，全部行照常显示 |
| **行 key 的 `groupPart` 形态** | 0.2.1 起一条节点按部分渲染：`response`/无部分用节点 key，其余（含 `reasoning`）用 `JSON.stringify([key, "reasoning"])` | 思考行隐藏不掉（**工具行仍会隐藏，看起来像"只漏了思考"**） |
| `data-chat-flow-kind="turn-process"` | 把被 seat 隐藏的控件行强制显示 | 运行中没有汇总行 |
| 思考行 `data-variant="think"` | 内联思考的兜底隐藏 | 少量内联思考露出 |
| shell 输出的 `[exit code: N]` / `[killed by signal: X]` 尾部标记 | 把命令失败算进 ✗ 并显示退出码 | 失败命令被计为成功（输出被 spill 截断时也会如此，因为没有标记可读） |
| `turn-process` 节点数据 `turn / processStartSeq / toolCallCount / messageCount / subagentCount` | 类别归属与汇总文案 | 数字不对或类别为空 |

别名键和 `groupPart` 两种形态都会发出去，所以 0.1.5（无 groupPart）与 0.2.1 都能用。

## kind 清单与版本漂移

节点 kind 是合并扩展的（`ChatNodeDataMap` 的键），随版本增长。当前 0.2.1 共 19 个：

- **永不折叠**：`system-prompt` `user` `steering` `turn-process` `turn-error` `turn-max-tokens` `turn-tail` `question-reply`
- **折叠**：`tool-call` `context` `model-retry`，以及按类别聚合的 `turn-trigger`（→「触发」）、`compaction`（→「上下文压缩」）、`command` / `command-input`（→「命令」）、`workflow-run`（→「工作流」）、`assistant-step`（思考并入口「思考」；无正文无思考的壳行直接折叠）

升级后跑一条命令自查：

```powershell
node ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/aura-cardea/tools/check-kinds.mjs C:\path\to\node_modules\@deepseek-ai
```

它扫描已安装的 client bundle，取出所有 `conversation.chat.node` 的 key 与 key 域，与插件规则表做 diff；
exit 0 = 全部有规则，1 = 有新增 kind（需决定收不收），2 = 没扫到任何包。
运维时未知 kind 也会在控制台 `warn` 一次，不会静默混进别的类别。

## 已知边界

- 折叠状态按轮次保存在组件内存里，切走会话再回来会收起
- 被隐藏的文本是 `display:none`，浏览器 Ctrl+F 搜不到（有意的取舍）
- 「系统提示词」行与轮次尾部（用量/用时）属于独立行，不参与折叠
- 子智能体的内部步骤不在父会话里（设计如此），父会话只有 `subagent ×N` 一行与条目详情
- 子智能体视图一次只挂一个对话，所以按轮次号作用域的思考兜底规则不会串到别的会话

## License

MIT

# Aura

[![aura-argus on npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/aura-argus?label=aura-argus&color=2f81f7)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aura-argus)
[![aura-cardea on npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/aura-cardea?label=aura-cardea&color=2f81f7)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aura-cardea)
[![aura-basetools on npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/aura-basetools?label=aura-basetools&color=2f81f7)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aura-basetools)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2ea44f)](LICENSE)
[![node: >=20](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-339933)](https://nodejs.org/)

[中文](README.zh.md)

Aura is a monorepo for independently installable tools. It is a distribution and maintenance boundary, not a shared runtime: each package has its own manifest, version, tests, and release cadence.

The shared constraints are deliberate:

- **Local-first.** No mandatory cloud account; data stays on the machine unless a tool explicitly retrieves a source.
- **Keyless where possible.** AuraArgus, AuraCardea, and AuraBasetools require no API key.
- **Agent-callable.** CLI, HTTP, MCP, and library surfaces are provided where they make sense.
- **MIT.** The code is readable, modifiable, and self-hostable.

---

## Projects

### AuraArgus — source-routed retrieval

AuraArgus routes a technical question to a registered official source, retrieves the page, extracts relevant passages, and returns an evidence bundle with URLs and scores. It also converts a URL into clean Markdown.

- 18 entities / 34 official sources currently registered.
- No API key, no per-call billing, zero runtime dependencies.
- Node.js ≥ 20; Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- CLI, HTTP, MCP stdio, and Node library surfaces.
- npm: [`aura-argus`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aura-argus)
- Source: [`aura-argus/`](aura-argus/README.md)

![Actual AuraArgus CLI output](docs/assets/aura-argus-output.svg)

*Actual output from v0.1.2, trimmed for display. The command and the retrieved passage are unmodified.*

```bash
npm i -g aura-argus
aura-argus search "SearXNG 对 429 的冷却时间是多少秒？" --json
aura-argus fetch https://docs.searxng.org/dev/search_api.html --max-chars 4000
```

MCP client configuration:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "aura-argus": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "aura-argus", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

**Scope.** AuraArgus is a registry-bound retrieval layer, not a general-purpose search engine. Unregistered entities return no evidence by default. Web fallback is opt-in and can be blocked by anti-bot pages. It does not log in, bypass CAPTCHAs, or generate an answer; the caller's model writes the answer from the returned passages.

### AuraCardea — DSH chat fold

AuraCardea is a web client plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It replaces the `conversation.chat.node` `turn-process` renderer and folds the intermediate rows of a turn — tool calls, reasoning, context injections, retries — into one row per kind. Category rows show success/failure counts and total duration; expanding a category reveals individual calls, parameters, output, exit codes, and image thumbnails.

- DSH 0.2.x web profile; Node.js ≥ 20.
- npm: [`aura-cardea`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aura-cardea)
- Source: [`aura-cardea/`](aura-cardea/README.md)
- Package shape: `dsh.bundle` with `cordis.patch.yml`, plus `dsh.client` for the browser half.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add aura-cardea
```

Then add the mount row to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: client-aura-cardea
      name: 'aura-cardea'
```

Restart `dsh web`. When the package is installed as a bundle through a configured plugin market, the bundle patch performs the mount automatically.

**Scope.** AuraCardea is DSH-specific. It does not add retrieval tools, alter model output, or provide a portable chat UI. It depends on DSH's chat DOM contracts, which can change between DSH versions; `tools/check-kinds.mjs` is included to detect new node kinds.

![AuraCardea in DSH: intermediate tool calls folded by kind](docs/assets/aura-cardea-ui.png)

*AuraCardea running in DSH 0.2.x from the published npm package. One turn's tool calls, reasoning, edits, and reads are folded by kind; each category row carries counts, failure markers, and duration.*

### AuraBasetools — byte-fidelity file tools for agents

AuraBasetools is a read / edit / write engine for coding agents that keeps bytes intact. Reads are intent-shaped — `map`, `digest`, `around`, `lines`, `search`, `changed`, plus a metadata-only `probe` — so a call returns the part that matters instead of the whole file. Edits address content (`old`), symbols (`target`), byte ranges (`handle`), or lines; stale regions are refused, and the file is read back to verify what landed.

- **Encodings:** UTF-8 (with or without BOM), UTF-16LE/BE, GB18030/GBK (including the 4-byte supplementary range), Shift_JIS, EUC-KR, Big5, Windows-1252. Writes go back in the file's own encoding and bytes outside the edit are preserved; ambiguous or non-reversible encodings are refused instead of guessed.
- **Structure:** 65 code extensions, plus documents and configs (`.md` with ATX and setext headings, `.json`/`.jsonc`/`.json5` key paths, `.yaml`, `.toml`).
- Zero runtime dependencies; Node.js ≥ 20; Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- CLI and MCP stdio; `aura-basetools-dsh` adds the DeepSeek Harness shell (`aura_basetools_*` tools).
- npm: [`aura-basetools`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aura-basetools), [`aura-basetools-dsh`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aura-basetools-dsh)
- Source: [`aura-basetools/`](aura-basetools/README.md)

```bash
npx -y --package aura-basetools aura basetools mcp   # MCP server, zero install
npm i -g aura-basetools                              # CLI
dsh plugin --profile web add aura-basetools-dsh      # DSH plugin
```

**Scope.** AuraBasetools is a file layer, not a search engine or an agent: it does not decide what to edit, generate patches, or index a repository. On the DSH surface it sees host-decoded text only, so non-UTF-8 files are handled through the CLI or MCP. The strongest guarantee it makes is byte-level: if a file cannot be reproduced byte-for-byte, the write is refused.

---

## Verification

Last verified: **2026-10-22**. Network-dependent checks are not part of CI. The evaluation is a fixed internal regression set, not a public benchmark.

| Package | Check | Result |
|---|---|---|
| AuraArgus `0.1.2` | `npm test` | 51 / 51 |
| | `node eval/run.mjs` | 31 questions; 141 / 141 hard checks |
| | `node eval/verify.mjs` | 34 / 34 registered sources reachable |
| | Public npm install (`npm i -g aura-argus@0.1.2`) | 4 tools; `initialize` and `tools/list` verified; CLI `version` and `search` verified |
| AuraCardea `1.1.0` | `node tools/check-kinds.mjs` | 19 / 19 discovered kinds have a rule |
| | `npm pack` | 7 files; 23.7 kB packed |
| | Host import, client syntax, `npm install` | verified |
| | Public profile install (`dsh plugin ... aura-cardea@1.1.0`) | package resolves as `aura-cardea`; bundle metadata present |
| | DSH UI after restart | public bundle loaded; folded view verified (screenshot above) |
| | DSH MCP + web provider after restart | MCP `search` returned registry evidence; `web_search` returned the same official source |

**AuraBasetools `0.21.0`** (verified 2026-10-25): `node build/release-check.mjs` exited 0 (full suite; encoding 34, doc-map 45, probe 21 among the assertions), and `node build/post-publish-check.mjs --registry --version 0.21.0` passed 24 / 24 with the published files byte-identical to the local dist.

Two AuraArgus soft checks are intentionally disabled because web fallback is opt-in; they are reported separately from the hard suite and are not counted as passes.

The public packages were installed from the npm registry on 2026-10-22 and `dsh web` was restarted. The screenshot above is from that run. The DSH MCP `search` call returned registry evidence, and the DSH web provider returned the same official source. AuraCardea's UI is still manually inspected; no automated browser test is included.

Reproduction:

```bash
cd aura-argus
npm test
node eval/run.mjs
node eval/verify.mjs

cd ../aura-cardea
npm pack
node tools/check-kinds.mjs <dsh-node-modules>/@deepseek-ai
```

---

## How it compares

### AuraArgus: scope comparison, not a benchmark

| Dimension | AuraArgus | General search API | Keyless SERP | Documentation chatbot |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Coverage | Registered entities: 18 / 34 sources | Broad web | Broad web | A selected documentation corpus |
| Credentials | None | API key | None | Usually an account or key |
| Billing | None | Per request | None | Varies |
| Output | Passages with URL and score | Snippets with URL | Links and snippets | Generated prose |
| Strength | Traceable official-source evidence | Recall and freshness | No key | Fluent synthesis |
| Main limitation | Not a general web index | Cost, key management | Stability and anti-bot blocking | Provenance is indirect |

AuraArgus is not positioned as a replacement for general web search. It is appropriate when the question belongs to a registered entity and the caller needs citable passages from the official source. For open-web recall, a general search API remains the appropriate tool.

### AuraCardea: presentation layer, not a chat platform

| Dimension | AuraCardea | DSH default chat rendering |
|---|---|---|
| Scope | DSH 0.2.x web | DSH web |
| Intermediate rows | Folded by kind with counts, timings, and inline details | Shown as individual rows |
| Portability | DSH-only | DSH-only |
| Model behavior | Unchanged | Unchanged |
| Telemetry | None added | Not applicable |

AuraCardea does not claim to improve model quality. It changes the density and scanability of an existing turn, at the cost of coupling to DSH's chat DOM.

---

## Repository access

Installing a package does not require cloning this repository. For source inspection:

### Sparse checkout

```bash
git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/Ck-epsilon/Aura.git
cd Aura
git sparse-checkout set aura-cardea
```

Replace `aura-cardea` with `aura-argus` or `aura-basetools` for another package.

### degit

```bash
npx degit Ck-epsilon/Aura/aura-cardea aura-cardea
```

### Package managers

```bash
npm i -g aura-argus
npm i aura-cardea
npm i -g aura-basetools
```

## Repository layout

```text
Aura/
  README.md
  README.zh.md
  LICENSE
  docs/assets/
  aura-argus/          # retrieval: CLI / HTTP / MCP / Node library
  aura-cardea/         # DSH web client plugin
  aura-basetools/      # byte-fidelity read/edit: CLI / MCP / DSH plugin
```

Each package is independently publishable. Its manifest points back to this repository:

```json
"repository": {
  "type": "git",
  "url": "https://github.com/Ck-epsilon/Aura",
  "directory": "aura-cardea"
}
```

---

## Conventions

- **npm name:** `aura-<product>` (`aura-argus`, `aura-cardea`, `aura-basetools`).
- **Product name:** `AuraXxx` in prose and UI.
- **Versioning:** independent semver per package; recommended tags are `aura-cardea-v1.1.0`.
- **DSH packages:** declare both `dsh.bundle` and `dsh.client`; use `engines.dsh` for the supported DSH range.
- **No shared runtime:** packages do not depend on each other. A small amount of duplication is preferred to a premature shared abstraction.
- **No mandatory root workspace:** each package can be tested and released on its own.

Each package is versioned and released independently; see its README for the current version.

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # Codewhale Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness A `dsh` bundle: one patch layer that adds the Computer Use MCP tool surface to a profile. Install the [desktop app](../../README.md#the-mac-app) first — it owns the macOS Accessibility and Screen Recording grants, and this package points at the server inside it rather than shipping its own. ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @codewhale/computer-use-dsh ``` `dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm and then reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles`, so that one command both installs the package and adds its layer to the profile. The tools arrive as `mcp__computer-use__`. The two skills install separately, because a profile whose agent presets own skill discovery ignores a host-level `skill-filesystem` row. The user skill root is read in every composition: ```bash PLUGIN="$HOME/Applications/Codewhale Computer Use.app/Contents/Resources/plugin" mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills ln -sfn "$PLUGIN/skills/computer-use" ~/.dsh/skills/computer-use ln -sfn "$PLUGIN/skills/recording" ~/.dsh/skills/recording ``` ## Environment | Variable | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `CODEWHALE_CU_SERVER` | `~/Applications/Codewhale Computer Use.app/Contents/Resources/plugin/mcp/server.mjs` | The MCP server to run. Point it at a `/Applications` install or a source checkout's `mcp/server.mjs`. | ## Removing it ```bash dsh plugin --profile web remove @codewhale/computer-use-dsh rm ~/.dsh/skills/computer-use ~/.dsh/skills/recording ``` # Computer Use **By Codewhale · macOS beta (notarized app and source) · Windows experimental unsigned preview · Linux experimental: X11 verified on a virtual desktop (Xvfb + openbox) and in the Docker test image, from source; Wayland input on sway (verified on headless sway), other Wayland desktops observation only** The [0.12.0 release](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/codewhale-cu-plugin/releases/tag/v0.12.0) provides the notarized universal Mac app and an **unsigned Windows x64 preview**. The Windows ZIP bundles Node and includes setup instructions; it is intended for testing, with physical-device, mixed-DPI and signing acceptance still open. Let Codewhale see and operate your apps — through whichever interface fits each step: app scripting (AppleScript/JXA) where apps ship a dictionary, accessible controls, text entry, click, scroll and capture through the same MCP tools. The macOS helper keeps permissions and human controls in one menu-bar app. - **Set up once.** See Accessibility and Screen Recording status, open the right Settings pane, then run a check in a disposable practice window. - **Keep working.** macOS selects apps in background mode by default. Accessibility actions and process-directed typing remain available. Actions that need a keyboard-focus lease refuse before delivery; use browser control, a separate computer, or explicit foreground selection of the approved app for those tasks. That app's existing approval covers foreground selection without another prompt; human-input yielding and Pause/Stop remain. - **Stay in control.** See selected apps and their input modes. Pause cancels queued work and releases held input; Stop ends existing sessions. Only the person using the menu-bar controls can allow input again. - **Update deliberately.** The app checks for stable releases on request. Updates verify the digest, Codewhale signature and Apple notarization before replacing the app, and retain the previous install for rollback. [Setup page](https://codewhale.net/computer-use) · [Setup and troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) · [Release notes](CHANGELOG.md) · [Distribution](docs/DISTRIBUTION.md) · [Background demo](docs/DEMO.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Security](SECURITY.md) ## Install Three doors, same destination — pick one: 1. **Mac app (easiest).** Download the disk image from the latest stable [GitHub release](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/codewhale-cu-plugin/releases), drag it to Applications, and open it. Open **Computer Use…** from the whale menu-bar icon, grant what it asks (Accessibility, then Screen Recording), and run the background check. No terminal, no Node, no compiler needed. 2. **Inside Codewhale.** Computer Use ships built in: review, trust and enable it through Codewhale's plugin panel. Current macOS Engine builds include the native helper; you do not need a second app installation. Run `request_access` and follow its actual permission owner and setup hint. An installed Computer Use app remains the control owner when present. 3. **From source.** Clone, test, install: ```bash git clone https://github.com/codewhale-hq/codewhale-cu-plugin cd codewhale-cu-plugin npm test # unit + protocol, no GUI input performed npm run build:app # dist/{macos,linux,windows} npm run install:app # puts the app in place, registers it, opens it once ``` Needs Node 20+ and, on a Mac, Xcode Command Line Tools. Then wire your host from the table in [Developer quick start](#developer-quick-start). **Verify (every door).** Ask your host for `request_access`. It identifies the computer, helper/version, available tools and missing permissions without sending input. `via: "app"` means grants belong to the Computer Use app; `via: "direct"` means they belong to the hosting app or terminal. Follow that receipt's `appHint`, not a second install ceremony. An installed but disconnected helper is an error, never permission to bypass it. Permission recovery is in [Setup and troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md). **Choose your surface.** Apps on this Mac use Computer Use; your signed-in Chrome uses [Codewhale for Chrome](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/codewhale-plugin-marketplace/tree/main/plugins/chromewhale); a clean browser uses Computer Use's `browser` tool. `/computer status` checks the first route; Chrome has its own connector and per-site grants. **Operating guidance.** The server sends its concise packaged skill in standard MCP `initialize.instructions`. Hosts that consume that field can supply it before the first action. `resources/list` / `resources/read` expose the exact same guide plus detailed operations, refusal recovery and recording references. This supplies guidance; host-side delivery/logging and approvals remain the host's responsibility. Engine support is maintained separately. **Capture identity.** Current source returns `raster_id` on screenshot, zoom and OCR receipts. Repeat it in pixel targets and parent zooms; newer captures refuse older pins before input. Nested zooms crop the bound parent file. The packaged guide teaches this through the existing MCP instructions/resources. This does not establish that the UI stayed unchanged or that the current source shipped in the installed helper. [Cua comparison and remaining parity](docs/CUA_PARITY.md) records the upstream reference and proof gaps. **Status.** Release status is recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). The notarized Mac app is published on this repository's [GitHub releases](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/codewhale-cu-plugin/releases) (stable release: v0.12.0; this checkout prepares 0.12.1); remaining gates are tracked in [the release checklist](docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md). The [setup page](https://codewhale.net/computer-use) offers the notarized disk image directly. The native setup panel, background check and updater require **macOS 13.5+** for the self-contained bundle. The source MCP server includes experimental Windows and Linux backends, with HarmonyOS devices over hdc. Windows ships only as an unsigned x64 preview ZIP and Linux remains source and Docker: neither has the native human controls, exact-window targeting or a qualified signed installer, and both are excluded from the plugin's public host eligibility until those gates pass. Their raw input uses the shared desktop and must not be treated as background control. Windows semantic mutations bind the observed window and element runtime identities and refuse stale paths. See the [publication review](docs/PUBLICATION_REVIEW.md) and [porting plan](docs/PORTING.md). The SSH route remains experimental. See the platform-specific [limitations](docs/LIMITATIONS.md). The server works with MCP hosts including Codewhale, Kimi Code, Claude Code, Codex CLI and Cursor. It has zero runtime npm dependencies. Developer checkouts use Node 20+; the macOS distribution includes a pinned Node 24 LTS runtime. Codewhale still reviews, trusts and enables a plugin through its existing Engine authority before the model can use it. ## The Mac app The notarized universal app ships as a drag-to-Applications disk image on this repository's [GitHub releases](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/codewhale-cu-plugin/releases), only from a published stable release whose `release.json` receipt qualifies; the ZIP archive on the same release is what the in-app updater installs. The plugin marketplace links there, and the [setup page](https://codewhale.net/computer-use) offers the image directly. Release status is recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). To build and install from source instead, use door 3 in [Install](#install). See [docs/DISTRIBUTION.md](docs/DISTRIBUTION.md) for the packaging, notarization and release procedure. ## Developer quick start Choose the appropriate setup route ([Install](#install)), then point your host at the server: | Host | Configuration | |---|---| | Codewhale | Discovers the Agent Plugins v1 bundle (`plugin.json` + `mcp.json`); nothing to configure. | | Kimi Code | Run `/plugins install /path/to/codewhale-cu-plugin`, then `/reload`. The native `kimi.plugin.json` registers the server and skills. | | DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) | `dsh plugin --profile web add @codewhale/computer-use-dsh`, then link `skills/` into `~/.dsh/skills`. See [DeepSeek Harness](#deepseek-harness-dsh). | | Claude Code | `claude mcp add computer -- node /path/to/mcp/server.mjs` | | Codex CLI | `~/.codex/config.toml`: `[mcp_servers.computer]` `command = "node"` `args = ["/path/to/mcp/server.mjs"]` | | Cursor / Windsurf / VS Code | `{"mcpServers":{"computer":{"command":"node","args":["/path/to/mcp/server.mjs"]}}}` | | Gemini CLI | same JSON in `~/.gemini/settings.json` | | opencode | `{"mcp":{"computer":{"type":"local","command":["node","/path/to/mcp/server.mjs"]}}}` | `/path/to/mcp/server.mjs` can be this checkout or the stable copy inside the installed app (`install:app` prints it — on macOS `~/Applications/Codewhale Computer Use.app/Contents/Resources/plugin/mcp/server.mjs`). `npm link` also gives you a `codewhale-cu` command for hosts that want one. ### Kimi Code Install the desktop helper above first, then use Kimi's `/plugins install` command with this checkout's absolute path. Review the local plugin and choose **Trust and install**. Kimi copies it into its managed plugin directory and enables its MCP server. Run `/reload` in an existing session, then `/mcp`: `plugin-codewhale-computer-use:computer` should show **connected** and the tool list (37 advertised in 0.9.0; counts vary by host). `/plugins info codewhale-computer-use` shows the installed version and status. This flow was verified with Kimi Code 0.41.0. See the [Kimi plugin documentation](https://moonshotai.github.io/kimi-code/en/customization/plugins.html) for managed updates and removal. The server needs Node 20 or newer on Kimi's PATH and uses the installed Codewhale permission helper. Existing MCP servers and model settings are preserved. Models without vision can read the default text observations and request local macOS OCR; models with vision can also request screenshots. ### DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Install the desktop helper above first, then add the bundle in [`integrations/dsh`](integrations/dsh). `dsh` manages a profile's plugins as npm packages: `dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm in the profile directory and then reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles`, so one command installs the package *and* adds its patch layer to the profile. ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @codewhale/computer-use-dsh ``` Use the path to this checkout's `integrations/dsh` instead of the package name to install from source. The tools arrive as `mcp__computer-use__`; the bundle runs the server from the installed app with the Node already running `dsh`, so nothing else needs configuring. Set `CODEWHALE_CU_SERVER` to point at a `/Applications` install or a source checkout's `mcp/server.mjs`. The two skills install separately. A profile whose agent presets own skill discovery — the `web` profile is one — disables the host-level `skill-filesystem` row, so a bundle cannot reach it. The user skill root is read in every composition: ```bash PLUGIN="$HOME/Applications/Codewhale Computer Use.app/Contents/Resources/plugin" mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills ln -sfn "$PLUGIN/skills/computer-use" ~/.dsh/skills/computer-use ln -sfn "$PLUGIN/skills/recording" ~/.dsh/skills/recording ``` To scope desktop control to sessions that ask for it rather than every session on the profile, put the same `mcp-computer-use` row in an agent preset instead of installing the bundle: duplicate `standard` in the `dsh` UI, then add the row from `integrations/dsh/cordis.patch.yml` to the copy's `agent.cordis.yml` and set `customSkillDirs` on its `skill-filesystem`. A preset whose rows cannot be resolved is listed as broken with the reason, so a typo shows up in the picker rather than at session start. Verified with `dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1 and plugin 0.6.0 on macOS: `dsh plugin add` into a profile, 44 tools bridged, both skills in the catalog, and a live `computer_list` call returning from the helper. Remove it with `dsh plugin --profile web remove @codewhale/computer-use-dsh`. Models without vision read the default text observations and can request local macOS OCR; models with vision can also request screenshots, which `dsh` bridges as attachments. ## The desktop app macOS grants Accessibility and Screen Recording to the *responsible process* of a permission check. A bare `node mcp/server.mjs` inherits its host's identity, so the grant lands on Terminal, Cursor, or Claude, and every host needs its own. The app fixes that: - **What it is** — a tiny native launcher (`app/macos/launcher.c` on macOS) that runs `app/daemon.mjs`, a long-lived process that executes the platform backend and answers one-line JSON requests over a per-user socket (`~/.codewhale-cu/app.sock`, a named pipe on Windows). Only the same allow-listed tool set the ssh agent accepts will execute; the socket is never a shell. - **How the server uses it** — every call on the local computer goes through the app when it is running. If it is installed but not running, the server launches it (via LaunchServices on macOS, so it is its own responsible process) and waits for it. If it is not installed, calls run directly in the server process as before. `request_access` reports which mode is active (`via: "app"` or `"direct"`) and, in direct mode, how to install the app. A registered helper takes priority over Codewhale's embedded native helper; if the registered helper cannot start, input fails closed. Without a standalone registration, Codewhale can use its embedded permission identity. `CODEWHALE_CU_APP=off` is an explicit developer override for direct mode, never an agent workaround for the person's Pause or Stop choice. - **First launch** — open the whale menu to review permission status. Only the setup buttons request grants; starting the helper does not prompt automatically. Where `install:app` puts things: | OS | App | Also | |---|---|---| | macOS | `~/Applications/Codewhale Computer Use.app` (registered with LaunchServices) | `--login`: `~/Library/LaunchAgents/net.codewhale.computer-use.plist` | | Linux | `~/.local/share/codewhale-computer-use` | `~/.local/bin/codewhale-computer-use`, `~/.local/share/applications/net.codewhale.computer-use.desktop`, hicolor icons; `--login`: `~/.config/autostart/` | | Windows | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Codewhale Computer Use` | Start Menu shortcut with icon; `--login`: Startup-folder shortcut | ### macOS permission recovery The build signs the complete app bundle, and installation signs again after pinning Node, then verifies the installed signature. Signing only the launcher leaves an invalid app identity: macOS can show an enabled switch while refusing the grant and repeatedly prompting for Accessibility. If upgrading from that broken package, remove the old Codewhale Computer Use entry from Accessibility, add `~/Applications/Codewhale Computer Use.app`, and enable it. Refresh its Screen & System Audio Recording grant and restart the helper. The probe must report Accessibility `granted` and screen capture `ok`; `via: "app"` alone is not a pass. Authentication in System Settings is handled by the user. Never modify the TCC database. Builds use `CODEWHALE_CU_SIGN_IDENTITY` when configured, otherwise an available Developer ID or Apple Development identity, and fall back to ad-hoc signing. Ad-hoc updates can require a new grant. Installation preserves the selected identity and verifies the finished bundle. Building the native macOS helper requires Xcode Command Line Tools on a Mac; the Codewhale distribution embeds the compiled helper. Do not edit installed resources without re-signing. ### Background control and visible cursor on macOS Use `open_application` with `activate: false` to select the input destination without bringing it forward. Keyboard events go to that process and semantic actions use Accessibility — both are quiet: no cursor movement, no activation. Unqualified `get_app_state`, `list_windows`, and `screenshot` follow that app, including behind other windows. Explicit display/region captures remain available once the user has approved at least one app on the computer. Text insertion prefers writable accessibility selection over process key events. For an authorized workflow that requires keyboard focus, explicitly select `activate: true`; receipts then say `keyboard_delivery: "foreground-guarded"`. Keystrokes and raw mouse gestures stop if another app takes focus; gestures never reactivate it. Select `activate: false` again to return to process-bound delivery. In either mode, verify the application result: a successful dispatch alone does not prove the app handled it. Coordinate `left_click` first resolves the bound application's accessibility control and uses accessibility (`strategy: "a11y"`). Text fields focus directly, rows can select, and menu items can use their advertised pick action. Right-click uses an advertised context-menu action. Background scrolling uses the selected scrollbar: native increments when advertised, otherwise normalized 5% steps, with the actual unit and value change in the receipt. Unsupported gestures, including raw double/triple/middle click, drag and hover, remain unavailable in background mode. There is no automatic foreground fallback. When the authorized task needs focus in an approved app, select `activate: true` for foreground control without a second approval prompt. Raw clicks, hover, drag and wheel then go to the bound app's window as window-routed event records (`strategy: "window-record"`, `pointer_moved: false`) — the agent has its own pointer, drawn in the preview, and **the user's cursor is never moved, warped or held on macOS**. There is no real-cursor fallback: a helper that cannot resolve the window route refuses `bg_dispatch_unavailable`. `pointer` down/move/up buffer a drag and deliver it to the window on `up`. Return to `activate: false` when the foreground step ends. `activate: false` is the default on every platform, not just macOS: Windows launches the app minimized and Linux hands focus back to the previous window after launch. Raw input on Windows and Linux is still shared-surface by nature — background there means the launch does not steal focus, not that input becomes background-safe. The binding receipt exposes `input_scope`, `shared_pointer: false`, `pointer_route: "window-record"` and `isolated_desktop: false`. The preview title distinguishes background app control from shared-desktop control. It is a view of the app, not a sandbox. Only when the user asks to watch, enable `preview` with `enabled: true` to show a small, nonactivating window containing the controlled app and a cyan cursor labeled Codewhale. The preview refreshes on a timer while a session is bound (`CODEWHALE_CU_PREVIEW_REFRESH_MS`, default 1000; 0 disables), so it behaves like a live view of the app instead of a frozen still; its cursor is separate from the hardware pointer. Close the panel or use `enabled: false` to hide it — and the session that showed the panel hides it when it closes, so no panel outlives its session. ### Consent and shared-machine manners on the local computer On `local`, the app — not the tool — is the unit of trust. The first call that targets an application (`open_application`, an `app_ref`, an element or `state_id`, an action on the bound app, or an observation that names no app and so would use the frontmost one on macOS) refuses `consent_required` until the user decides. A whole-screen `screenshot`, `zoom` or `recording` start, which names no app, refuses until the user has approved at least one app on that computer (and, on macOS, while the app in front is one they denied); after that it is not per-app (it shows everything on the screen), so capture one app with `app_ref` when the rest of the screen should stay private; the model asks them and records the answer with `consent {action:"allow"|"deny", app:"…"}`. Decisions cover the session by default and persist with `remember:true`; `consent {action:"status"}` shows the ledger and `revoke` clears it. A denial is a wall: the ledger folds name, bundle id and pid together, so a denied app fails `app_denied` under every spelling and cannot be opened, driven, or killed through this surface. The same app approval covers explicit `open_application activate:true` without recording a global foreground grant. A recorded foreground denial still blocks it; revoking the app grant removes foreground access too. Spawned computers are exempt (a task-owned desktop holds nothing of the user's); remote computers are covered by their transport's trust; `app_script` keeps macOS's own Automation consent. In explicitly selected foreground mode for an approved app, whenever a shared surface is taken — a front lease for window-record input, a real-pointer gesture, foreground keys, or an activation — the helper waits for a gap in the user's hardware input first (bounded, ~450 ms gap within a 2.5 s window by default; `CODEWHALE_CU_YIELD_GAP_MS` / `CODEWHALE_CU_YIELD_WAIT_MS`). If no quiet window arrives, the call refuses `user_busy` before sending input. Successful receipts report the wait as `yield_ms`. Turn-taking, not a lock: `user_input_during_lease` still reports input that arrived mid-action. ### Browser control (CDP) `browser` drives a Chromium-family browser over the Chrome DevTools protocol in a self-owned profile under the state dir — the person's own browser is never attached to, typed into, or closed. `start {url?}` launches (or reuses) the instance and binds this session's own tab; `navigate`, `click` (a CSS selector's box center, or a page-viewport point), `type` (optional selector + `enter`), `screenshot`, `status`, and `stop` follow. Page screenshots return as inline images like screen captures do. `stop` closes this session's tab; the shared browser goes down when no tabs remain. Coordinates in this family are page-viewport pixels (`space: "page-viewport"`) — never screen points. Node 22+ is required for the WebSocket transport; older runtimes refuse with `unsupported_runtime`. This is background control of a local app, not an isolated desktop. Some apps, system dialogs, and workflows may still require foreground interaction. The opt-in `node scripts/verify-macos.mjs` test exercises a uniquely named TextEdit fixture (closed automatically afterward; add `--preview` to test the overlay), Unicode input, selection, screenshots and foreground preservation through a fresh MCP connection. Recording is separately opt-in with `--recording`. It creates local receipts and is separate from the automated unit suite. Logs: `~/Library/Logs/Codewhale Computer Use/app.log` (macOS), `~/.local/state/codewhale-computer-use/app.log` (Linux), `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Codewhale Computer Use\app.log` (Windows). `npm run remove:app` reverses the install. Every bundle carries a complete runtime copy of the plugin, so hosts can target the installed path and survive deleting this checkout. ## Session ownership Each MCP connection has independent computer selection, application binding, rasters, accessibility observations and held-input ownership. Local actions are serialized by the permission-owning app; stopping or cancelling one session releases its own held input. Normal client shutdown closes the app session; losing the client connection also cancels and releases its input. On macOS, the native input helper also releases its press when its owning process disappears, including in direct mode. On macOS, session exit stops a recording started by that session; cancelling an ordinary request leaves an explicitly started recording running until stopped or the session exits. Session protocol 2 (introduced in 0.2.1) is required: upgrade the helper and restart existing MCP connections together. An old client or helper is refused with an upgrade error instead of sharing another client's input state. ## Frontier ability set The advertised surface is merged for context economy — `click`, `pointer`, `clipboard`, `recording`, `computer`, `browser`, with `key {duration}` covering holds; `list_sessions`, `kill_app`, `set_window_frame` and `trajectory` ride alongside as themselves, and `list_apps {installed:true}` returns the installed catalog rather than running processes. ### Capability grants `CODEWHALE_CU_GRANT` narrows a server process at launch: `read-only`, or a comma list of tool names (a merged name expands to its whole action set). `tools/list` advertises only granted tools, ungranted calls fail as `not_granted` before validation, and the app daemon enforces the same set on the session lease so a narrowed server cannot smuggle one through. Cleanup and `stop_computer_control` are never blocked; `request_access` reports the grant. The per-action wire names (`left_click`, `read_clipboard`, `recording_start`, `computer_list`, `hold_key`, …) remain callable as aliases, so pinned hosts and receipts keep working; `tools/list` advertises the merged set only. - **Observe & resolve** — `list_apps` (regular apps by default; `all:true` for helpers), `list_windows`, `list_displays`, `switch_display`, `get_app_state` (accessibility/UIA/uitest tree with element indices + `state_id`), `screenshot` (display/region, raster-bound coordinates), `zoom` (close-up crop of the last raster), `cursor_position`, `open_application` (exact-name rule), `request_access` (fail-closed permission/capability probe), `wait_for` (poll the accessibility tree until a query/role appears or disappears, then act on the fresh `state_id`). - **Pointer** — `click` (left/double/triple/right/middle through `button`/`clicks`), `pointer` (move/down/up), `left_click_drag`, `scroll` (4 directions). - **Keyboard & text** — `type` (unicode), `key` (chords, `repeat`, or `duration` to hold), `set_value` (semantic, background-safe), `select_text`, `perform_action` (element's own actions: AXPress / UIA Invoke / AT-SPI / uitest), `invoke_menu` (menu items by title path; accessibility only — no key events or focus lease; window-targeted items may need a key window). - **Scripting** — `app_script` (macOS, local computer): AppleScript or JXA through osascript into apps that ship a scripting dictionary — the programmatic interface to prefer over clicking wherever one exists. Returns stdout as `result`; refusals are typed (`script_error`, `script_timeout`, `automation_denied` for a declined/missing Automation consent). Refused on ssh/docker/hdc computers: a remote channel stays computer-use only, never a shell. - **Guidance & policy** — the operating skill ships as MCP resources (`skills/list`, `skills/get`, `resources/read` of `skill://codewhale-cu/…`, sha256 manifest) and as the `skills/computer-use/` pack in this repo; every tool advertises MCP annotations (readOnly / destructive / idempotent / openWorld) for host approval and sandbox policy. - **Recording** — `recording` (start/stop/status/list; see below). - **Computers** — `computer` (list/switch/register with ssh agent auto-push/spawn/remove). `spawn {id, transport:"docker"}` provisions a task-owned disposable Linux desktop container: it is registered `owned:true`, becomes active, takes every tool unchanged through the same agent protocol as ssh, and is destroyed by `remove` or when the MCP session ends, and stops after its lifetime (six hours by default). A computer is an execution environment — prefer a spawned desktop for work that does not need the user's own session, and keep `local` for the tasks that do. - **Safety** — `stop_computer_control` kill switch; permission probes that name the missing grant; receipts on every call naming the computer it happened on. ## Requirements Tools and permissions are probed at call time; `request_access` reports what is missing and every capability **fails closed naming the missing tool or permission** — it never guesses and never half-acts. - **macOS** — Accessibility + Screen Recording for the app (or, in direct mode, for the terminal that hosts the server). python3+pyobjc or cliclick improves cursor r

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-motion

![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-motion)

> **Unofficial community plugin.** Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.
> The name is descriptive (`motion` = animation); if the upstream project needs it, this package will be renamed.

**代码生成的数学 / 科普动画**，给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 用的插件。
画面由代码逐帧生成，不经过任何文生视频（text-to-video）模型。

提供六个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `motion_frames` | **极简模式（默认）**：直接从场景出帧，不生成视频、不用 HF；几秒拿到 storyboard PNG 与 layout 问题；输出落 `<project>/out/frames` |
| `motion_doctor` | **环境预检（一次调用）**：运行时 + 真实可用字体清单 + 公式转换 + API/函数/rate；按指纹缓存 12 h（不再按 Node 版本分叉） |
| `motion_setup` | **环境自愈**：建 venv、装 manimgx/sympy（`tts=true` 加 edge-tts）；在宿主进程执行，不受模型 bash 沙箱限制 |
| `motion_render` | 渲染 Manim / manimgx 场景；必须有 `motion.project.json`，`APPROVALS.json` 是前置账本（已通过就直接渲，未通过才走一次平台审批）；输出落 `<project>/out/render` |
| `motion_probe` | 成片抽帧拼 contact sheet，报告全黑/过曝，并给出 fps/帧数/VFR/CFR |
| `formula_check` | 用 SymPy 判断两个表达式是否恒等 |

外加三个技能：`animation-router`（题材路由 + API/命令速查）、`design-spec`（写 DESIGN.md）、`qa-rubric`（交付自检）。
它们由插件通过 `ctx.skills` 注册，**安装后自动出现在会话技能目录**，不需要再复制到 `~/.dsh/skills`。

模块边界、进程拓扑、数据流与不变量见 [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md)；设计理由与外部调研见
[docs/ai-native-motion.md](docs/ai-native-motion.md)。

## 版本与发布说明

npm 页面只渲染 README，不提供每个版本的 release note；完整记录在
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases)。下面是当前版本摘要：

| 版本 | 日期 | 主要内容 |
|---|---|---|
| [0.10.0](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases/tag/v0.10.0) | 2026-10-26 | 需求卡点固定七题（含时长/帧率/受众/风格/旁白）；项目集收敛到会话工作区的 `dsh-motion-projects/`，解析不越界/不嵌套/无 legacy；账本通过后渲染不再逐次弹窗 |
| [0.9.1](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases/tag/v0.9.1) | 2026-10-26 | 文档：README 增加版本摘要与 Releases 链接（docs-only） |
| [0.9.0](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases/tag/v0.9.0) | 2026-10-26 | 项目根 manifest、审批门与审计、时间轴自检、TTS 缓存、VFR/CFR、运行账本、showcase 标准化 |
| [0.6.0](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases/tag/v0.6.0) | 2026-10-26 | 免费 edge-tts 旁白、词级 timing、SRT、混音 |
| [0.5.0](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases/tag/v0.5.0) | 2026-10-25 | requirements brief 硬门；无锁定时 `motion_frames` 拒绝出帧 |
| [0.4.3](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases/tag/v0.4.3) | 2026-10-25 | 预检合并为一次 `motion_doctor`，指纹缓存；TTL 边界修复 |
| [0.4.2](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases/tag/v0.4.2) | 2026-10-25 | render 规格生效；按帧数强制 CFR |
| [0.4.1](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases/tag/v0.4.1) | 2026-10-25 | 未 approved checkpoint 拒绝 render |
| [0.4.0](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases/tag/v0.4.0) | 2026-10-25 | 分档确认门、`APPROVALS.json`、pre-flight、CFR |
| [0.3.0](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases/tag/v0.3.0) | 2026-10-25 | 风格路由 registry/CLI；3b1b + whiteboard |
| [0.2.0](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases/tag/v0.2.0) | 2026-10-25 | Lemo 风格库、frames-first、showcase、probe/doctor 改进 |
| [0.1.1](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases/tag/v0.1.1) | 2026-10-25 | OIDC Trusted Publishing、npm badge、unofficial 标记 |
| [0.1.0](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/releases/tag/v0.1.0) | 2026-10-25 | 首个公开版本：4 个工具、3 个 skill |

`0.7.0` / `0.8.0` 未单独发布，改动已并入 `0.9.0`。

## 两种模式

| | 极简模式（默认） | 交付模式 |
|---|---|---|
| 画面来源 | `motion_frames`：按时间点直接出 PNG | `motion_render` → MP4 → HyperFrames 合成 |
| 是否需要 HF | 不需要 | 需要（字幕、编码；旁白/混音也可走本地免费路线） |
| 检查方式 | 看帧（读图），没有"渲染完再抽帧" | `motion_probe` / `hyperframes check` |
| 典型耗时 | 2–6 秒/次 | 数秒–数十秒；HF 合成为分钟级 |
| 什么时候用 | 写场景、调节奏、改版式 | 定稿后出片 |

先出帧、改到满意，再决定要不要渲染成片。`motion_probe` 是给已经存在的视频做体检的，不是默认步骤。

## 项目骨架、时间轴与账本

新项目用脚手架起，不要从空白开始：

```bash
node scripts/scaffold.mjs my-film --title "欧拉公式" --duration 30
node scripts/timeline-check.mjs dsh-motion-projects/my-film --strict
node scripts/run-report.mjs dsh-motion-projects/my-film --wall 752
```

- 模板生成 `motion.project.json` / `scene.py` / `timeline.json` / `timeline.py` / `narration.json` / `assemble.py` / `DESIGN.md`；
- **一个项目 = 一部片子**，放在**会话工作目录**下的 `dsh-motion-projects/<目录名>`（可用 `MOTION_PROJECTS_HOME` 改）；
- 项目集只有这一层：`dsh-motion-projects/registry.json` 是可删可重建的索引，不参与寻址；
- `motion.project.json` 是唯一项目根，`id` 在这里，目录改名不影响身份；`APPROVALS.json` / `out/` / `audio/` / `.dsh-motion/` 都相对它；
- 解析**不越界、不向上找**：workspace 外的 `scene.py` 一律 unmanaged；子目录里的项目会被拒绝（不允许嵌套）；
- 正式 `motion_render` 必须有项目根；临时场景只能出帧，或用 `--explore` 调试；
- 工具入参可以给**项目目录名**（`{"file": "my-film"}`）或场景文件的绝对路径；
- 仓库自带的 `showcase/*` 不在项目集内，跑它们用 `MOTION_PROJECTS_HOME=showcase`；
- 管理项目集：`node scripts/projects.mjs list|show|repair|rename|registry`；
- `timeline.py` 的 `TimedScene.cue()` 在运行时对比 `self.time`，落后超过 0.35s 打印 `[late]`；
- `timeline-check` 检查 cue 乱序/越界、旁白晚于画面、旁白压到下一拍；
- 每个项目写 `<project>/.dsh-motion/metrics.jsonl`，`run-report` 汇总 active / wall，避免把 compute 百分比当端到端收益；
- `motion_probe` 报 `vfr:true` 时，raw 只是中间片，交付前用 `assemble.py` 或 `motion_render` 归一成 CFR。

旁白 `narrate` 默认按文本/音色/语速缓存并并发 3 句；`mix --report-gaps` 输出每个旁白间隙的 dB。

## 风格库

默认 **瑞士动态排版（swiss-motion）**；另外四套按题材选。四套改编自 [Lemo-Opuscar](https://github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar)，`3b1b` 来自 Manim 社区，均非自创。

| 风格 | 适合 | 规范 |
|---|---|---|
| `swiss-motion`（默认） | 公式、定义、数据结论 | [STYLE](styles/swiss-motion/STYLE.md) · [tokens](styles/swiss-motion/tokens.json) |
| `dataviz` | 趋势、比较、分布、科学数据 | [STYLE](styles/dataviz/STYLE.md) · [tokens](styles/dataviz/tokens.json) |
| `blueprint` | 几何证明、结构、尺寸关系 | [STYLE](styles/blueprint/STYLE.md) · [tokens](styles/blueprint/tokens.json) |
| `whiteboard` | 科学解释、课程、机制说明 | [STYLE](styles/whiteboard/STYLE.md) · [tokens](styles/whiteboard/tokens.json) |
| `3b1b` | 线代、微积分、概率、神经网络 | [STYLE](styles/3b1b/STYLE.md) · [tokens](styles/3b1b/tokens.json) |

**参考与示例统一用 HyperFrames 的库**：[examples](https://hyperframes.heygen.com/examples)、[catalog](https://hyperframes.heygen.com/catalog)、[frame.md](https://hyperframes.heygen.com/prompting/design-systems)。本仓库不再内置样片/分集；`showcase/` 只放可复现的演示。

路由是显式的：`node scripts/route-style.mjs "<题材>"`（点名优先 → registry 打分 → 默认 `swiss-motion`；分数并列/为 0 时要求确认）。规则在 [styles/registry.json](styles/registry.json)。

迭代预算（首帧 ≤60s、输出 ≤30k、上下文 ≤100k、读图 ≤10）见 [docs/performance-budget.md](docs/performance-budget.md)。

开工前先过需求卡点：`npm run plan -- "竖屏抖音，讲导数，要旁白"`，会推断画幅、交付、风格的候选项，再交给 `ask_user_question`；能推断的不问。

项目 `DESIGN.md` 头部写 `style: <slug>` + `style_version: 1.0.0`。风格来源、HF 集成、抽帧能力与 Lemo 调研见 [docs/ai-native-motion.md](docs/ai-native-motion.md)。

## 演示

五个类别各一支 10 秒内短片，记录出帧/渲染耗时：

- 公式：[showcase/swiss-euler](showcase/swiss-euler)
- 数据：[showcase/dataviz-secant](showcase/dataviz-secant)
- 几何：[showcase/blueprint-pythagoras](showcase/blueprint-pythagoras)
- 白板：[showcase/whiteboard-derivative](showcase/whiteboard-derivative)
- 暗场数学：[showcase/3b1b-unit-circle](showcase/3b1b-unit-circle)

每个 showcase 目录都是标准项目（带 `motion.project.json`）；成片在 `final/`，生成物在 `out/`。
汇总见 [showcase/README.md](showcase/README.md)。

## 开工前确认

`requirements` / `start` 的确认必须带 `--confirmation <ask_user_question id>`；brief 哈希由脚本自动生成。

顺序是硬性的：

1. 需求卡点（画幅 / 交付 / 风格 / 受众 / 旁白）
2. 脚本 / 文案（逐句旁白、上屏文字、公式）
3. 分镜（镜头、秒数、画面、运动、字幕）
4. `DESIGN.md` + 3 张风格帧（只出帧，不渲染）
5. 交付清单（尺寸 / fps / 时长 / 文件 / 音频 / 字幕）
6. **用户明确说“可以开始 / 开始做 / 按这个执行”**

`motion_render` 只在账本没通过时才走 Harness 的 `ctx.approval.request`：
账本全 approved 说明需求/脚本/分镜/开工都确认过了，渲染不再重复问，只往审计里记一条
`ledger-approved`。账本缺失或未通过时用户在界面里确认一次，拒绝则渲染失败。
想恢复“每次渲染都问”，在插件配置里加 `confirmEveryRender: true`。
`APPROVALS.json` 始终是前置条件（CLI/无平台路径也会校验）。
拒绝、`--explore` 绕过、平台审批与跳过审批都会写进 `<project>/.dsh-motion/approvals.jsonl`。

`motion_frames` 也会拦：项目有账本、但需求没落全「时长 / 画幅 / 帧率 / 交付 / 风格 / 受众 / 旁白」时，直接拒绝出帧。
第一步永远是固定七题一次问完，然后落账：

```bash
npm run approvals -- init <project> --mode standard
npm run approvals -- set <project> requirements approved \
  --duration 30s --aspect 1920x1080 --fps 30fps --delivery narrated \
  --style 3b1b --audience high --narration zh-neutral \
  --confirmation q_... --note "用户确认"
```

没听到第 6 步的明确指令，不写完整场景、不出全片。清单模板见
[skills/animation-router/references/confirmation.md](skills/animation-router/references/confirmation.md)。

按体量分档：`light`（≤15 s 无旁白：脚本+分镜合并）、`standard`（15–60 s 或旁白）、`full`（>60 s 或多段，加 animatic）。确认状态落在项目里的 `APPROVALS.json`：

```bash
npm run approvals -- init <project> --mode light
npm run approvals -- set <project> start approved --confirmation q_... --note "用户说可以开始"
npm run approvals -- check <project>
```

## 安装

```bash
# npm
npm install -g dsh-motion

# 或在 DSH 插件管理器里安装 dsh-motion
```

安装后重启 DeepSeek Harness，然后先跑一次预检：

```
motion_doctor
```

它把运行时、真实可用字体、公式转换和 API/函数/rate 一次带回（按机器指纹缓存 12 小时，重复调用几乎不耗时）。
`ready.math=false` 时调用 `motion_setup`，不要自己用 bash 建 venv——venv 在 workspace 外，会被沙箱拒绝。

## 依赖

| 依赖 | 是否必需 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Node.js ≥ 22 | 必需 | `engines` 声明 |
| Python 3 + venv | 数学功能需要 | `manimgx`、`sympy`；极简出帧只需这一项 |
| FFmpeg + ffprobe | 成片/探针需要 | 后期与抽帧；出帧不需要；不随包分发 |
| Chrome | 用了 HF 才需要 | HyperFrames 优先复用系统 Chrome |
| HyperFrames | 交付模式需要 | `npx hyperframes`，不随包分发 |

### 准备 Python 环境

```bash
# 推荐：插件内 motion_setup，或命令行（幂等，缺什么补什么）
npm run setup
npm run setup -- --tts     # 旁白依赖 edge-tts / numpy
npm run setup -- --force   # 删掉旧 venv 重建

# 手动兜底
python3 -m venv ~/.dsh/data/dsh-motion/venv
~/.dsh/data/dsh-motion/venv/bin/pip install manimgx sympy
```

Windows 把 `bin/` 换成 `Scripts\`，可执行文件加 `.exe`。

## 配置

插件配置（或在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里传入）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: motion
      name: dsh-motion
      config:
        motionHome: ~/.dsh/data/dsh-motion
        workspace: <会话 cwd>/dsh-motion-projects      # 默认值；也可用 MOTION_PROJECTS_HOME
        venv: ~/.dsh/data/dsh-motion/venv
        python: /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.13   # 可选；默认找 python3.13/3.12/3.11/3
        packages: [manimgx, sympy, manimgx-fonts, manimgx-fonts-cjk]  # 可选；motion_setup 安装清单
        tts: false                             # 可选；true 时追加 edge-tts / numpy
        ffmpeg: /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg
```

解析顺序：插件配置 → 环境变量（`MOTION_HOME` / `MOTION_PROJECTS_HOME` / `MOTION_VENV` / `MOTION_FFMPEG`）→ 默认目录 → 系统 PATH。

## 快速开始

### 0. 先建项目

```bash
node scripts/scaffold.mjs demo --title "演示" --duration 10
cd dsh-motion-projects/demo
```

项目根由 `motion.project.json` 标识；正式渲染必须能找到它。临时场景可以只出帧，但不要用于交付。

### 1. 写一个 Manim 场景

```python
# scene.py
import manimgx as m
from manimgx import *

class Demo(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        ax = Axes(x_range=[-2, 2], y_range=[-1, 4])
        self.play(Create(ax))
        self.wait(1)
```

### 2. 先出帧（默认，不需要 HF）

```jsonc
// motion_frames
{ "file": "demo", "times": ["1.2", "4.5", "end"] }
```

返回 `storyboard` PNG 路径与 layout 问题清单（实测 3–4 帧约 3–5 秒）。看图改场景，不满意就再来一轮；这一步不生成 mp4，也不需要 HyperFrames。

### 3. 需要成片时再渲染

```jsonc
// motion_render
{ "file": "demo", "scene": "Demo", "width": 1920, "height": 1080, "fps": 60 }
```

### 4. 公式先验

```jsonc
// formula_check
{ "left": "diff(0.5*exp(x), x)", "right": "0.5*exp(x)" }
```

## 旁白（免费路线）

不依赖付费 API、不需要账号。默认用 [`edge-tts`](https://github.com/rany2/edge-tts)（微软 Edge 朗读接口的非官方封装：免费、联网、带词级时间戳）；离线兜底用 macOS `say`。

一次性准备：

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv-tts
.venv-tts/bin/pip install edge-tts numpy   # Windows: .venv-tts\Scripts\pip
```

`narration.json` 只描述文本和节拍，语音参数可以写在 `edge` 里，也可以命令行覆盖：

```json
{
  "duration": 30,
  "edge": { "voice": "zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural", "rate": "+10%" },
  "lines": [
    { "id": 1, "start": 0.65, "text": "先看这个函数……" }
  ]
}
```

生成逐句音频、词级 `timing.json` 和 `captions.srt`：

```bash
npm run narrate -- dsh-motion-projects/foo --voice zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural --rate +10%
```

混音（可选音乐、自动 duck、−14 LUFS / −1 dBTP），需要时直接压进现有视频：

```bash
npm run mix -- dsh-motion-projects/foo --music assets/bed.wav \
  --mux out/foo.mp4 --mux-out out/foo-narrated.mp4
```

| 产物 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `audio/edge/l1.mp3` | 逐句人声；按“文本 + 音色 + 参数”缓存 |
| `audio/edge/timing.json` | 每句起止 + 词级时间 |
| `audio/edge/captions.srt` | 与配音对齐的字幕 |
| `audio/master.wav` | 48 kHz / 24-bit 母带 |
| `audio/mix.json` | 响度、真峰值、duck 参数 |

没有网络时：

```bash
npm run narrate -- dsh-motion-projects/foo --provider say --voice Tingting --rate 230
```

`say` 不提供词级时间，字幕按 token 权重估算，并在 `timing.json` 标 `estimated`。Python 解释器可用 `--python` 或 `MOTION_TTS_PYTHON` 指定。

> `edge-tts` 免费但非官方接口：需要联网，无 SLA；商业发行建议换 Apache 2.0 的 Fun-CosyVoice3 或真人配音。

## 和 HyperFrames 的关系

本插件**不是**渲染框架，默认只产出画面素材；成片合成、字幕、编码交给 HyperFrames。旁白与混音可以用上面的免费路线，不强制走 HF：

```bash
npx hyperframes init my-video
npx hyperframes add data-chart          # 约 450 个现成 block / component
npx hyperframes check                   # 运行时、版式、对比度
npx hyperframes render -o out.mp4
```

- **风格契约**：HF 用 `frame.md`（`DESIGN.md` 的超集）做 brand truth；本仓库的 `DESIGN.md` / `styles/<name>/` 是同一套思路的轻量版，两边可以互读。
- **参考库**：不要把参考片塞进本仓库；直接看 HF 的 [examples](https://hyperframes.heygen.com/examples)、[catalog](https://hyperframes.heygen.com/catalog) 和 [frame.md templates](https://hyperframes.dev/design)。
- **分工**：manimgx 负责公式/坐标/几何这类确定性画面；HF 负责排版、图文、字幕与交付；免费旁白路线负责 TTS、时间轴与混音。
- **HF 不必先出片再截图**：`npx hyperframes snapshot <project> --at 2.9,10.4` 直接抓指定时刻的 PNG；`--frames 10 --review` 出 contact sheet；只有要完整序列时才 `render --format png-sequence`。

字幕建议“一份 transcript 出两个产物”：烧录进画面 + 独立 `.srt`。

## 故障排除

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `找不到 Python 虚拟环境` | 未建 venv | 调用 `motion_setup`（或 `npm run setup`），不要手动在 workspace 外建 |
| `找不到渲染器: …/manimgx` | venv 里没装 | `pip install manimgx` |
| `motion_frames` 报 layout 问题 | 压字 / 出画 / 字号过小 | 按返回的 `[n]` 逐条改场景；退出码 1 是“有问题”，不是崩溃 |
| 渲染断字 / 字体回退 | 字体未声明 `@font-face` | 把 `.woff2` 放工程 `assets/fonts/` 并声明 |
| `ffprobe` 缺失 | 只装了 ffmpeg | 装完整 FFmpeg，插件会退回 `ffmpeg -i` 解析 |
| 抽帧全黑 | 片头/片尾空镜 | 用 `tpad=stop_mode=clone` 补帧，或剪掉 |

## 本地开发（维护者）

桌面 App **独占** `desktop` profile，CLI 不能管理它（`dsh plugin --profile desktop` 会直接报错）。
把插件切到当前 checkout 的完整步骤、验证命令和禁忌清单记在
[MAINTAINING.md](https://github.com/cogito0823/dsh-motion/blob/main/MAINTAINING.md)。

一句话版本：插件管理器里**卸载** `dsh-motion` → **安装本地目录** `/path/to/dsh-motion` → `⌘⇧R` 重启；
之后 `motion_doctor` 第一行的「插件来源」会直接说明当前跑的是本地 checkout 还是 npm 安装。

日常改代码**不需要重装**：link 安装一次后，改 `lib/ops.js` / `lib/doctor.js` 会在下一次工具调用时按 mtime 热加载；只有改工具名/参数 schema 才需要 `⌘⇧R`。风格、`tokens.json`、场景文件本来就是运行时读取，不用重启。详见 [docs/dev-loop.md](docs/dev-loop.md)，也可以完全绕开 Harness：

```bash
node scripts/dev.mjs frames showcase/swiss-euler/scene.py 1,3,end   # → showcase/swiss-euler/out/frames/scene.png
node scripts/dev.mjs render --explore showcase/swiss-euler/scene.py --fps 30   # 演示项目无账本，仅调试
```

## 发版（维护者）

首次发布会把包名与 2FA 绑好；之后走 GitHub Actions 的 **Trusted Publishing**（OIDC），不需要 token、不需要 OTP，自动附带 **provenance 签名**。

### 一次性绑定

npm 包设置 → **Settings → Trusted Publisher → GitHub Actions**：

| 字段 | 值 |
|---|---|
| Organization or user | `cogito0823` |
| Repository | `dsh-motion` |
| Workflow filename | `release.yml` |
| Environment | 留空 |

Allowed actions：勾 **`npm publish`** 即可（`npm dist-tag` 用不到）。

### 发一版

```bash
npm version patch          # 0.1.0 -> 0.1.1
git push --follow-tags     # 触发 .github/workflows/release.yml
```

工作流会：校验 tag 与 `package.json` 版本一致 → `check` + `smoke` → `npm publish --provenance --access public`。

### 两个必须知道的坑

1. **npm CLI 必须 ≥ 11.5.1**。Node 22 自带的 npm 10 不支持 OIDC，会把占位 token 发出去，registry 返回误导性的 `404 not in this registry`。工作流里已加 `npm install -g npm@latest`。
2. **发布后不是立刻可见**。CLI 会打印 `Your package is being processed and may take a few minutes to become available`，通常 1–2 分钟后 `npm view` 才查得到。这不是失败。

### 验证

```bash
npm view dsh-motion version
npm view dsh-motion@<version> dist.attestations   # 应含 provenance / SLSA v1
```

npm 包页面会出现 **“Built and signed on GitHub Actions”**。

## 许可

MIT（见 `LICENSE`）。第三方依赖与调用关系见 `NOTICE.md`。
