evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-desktop-yida

> 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）装上一双手：**用 AI 直接创建、修改钉钉宜搭（Yida）应用**，并在右侧栏「宜搭工作台」里查看与打开应用。

这是一个 DSH 插件，基于开源 CLI [OpenYida](https://github.com/openyida/openyida) 封装。你用自然语言描述需求，AI 读 Schema、生成变更、跑命令、回读校验，最后把应用丢进右侧内置浏览器里给你看。

```
 你说话
   │
   ▼
 AI（DSH 里的模型）⇄ DSH 工具层 ⇄ dsh-desktop-yida（host 半）──spawn──▶ openyida CLI ──HTTPS──▶ 宜搭
                                        │
                                  /yida/api/*（只读，回环）
                                        │
                          client 半「宜搭工作台」⇄ DSH 内置浏览器标签页
```

---

## 目录

- [先认识四个名词](#先认识四个名词)
- [功能](#功能)
- [安装](#安装)
- [首次使用：登录宜搭](#首次使用登录宜搭)
- [使用方法](#使用方法)
- [安全闸门](#安全闸门)
- [配置项](#配置项)
- [常见问题](#常见问题)
- [兼容性](#兼容性)
- [合规提醒（请先读）](#合规提醒请先读)
- [开发](#开发)
- [License](#license)

---

## 先认识四个名词

| 名词 | 是什么 | 和本插件的关系 |
|---|---|---|
| **钉钉（DingTalk）** | 阿里旗下的企业协同办公平台 | 宜搭运行在钉钉生态内，账号、组织、权限都来自钉钉 |
| **宜搭（Yida）** | 钉钉的低代码平台：可视化拖拽配置页面、表单、流程，一键发布 | 本插件操作的目标系统。企业专属站点形如 `https://xxxxxx.aliwork.com` |
| **[OpenYida](https://github.com/openyida/openyida)** | 开源（MIT）的宜搭命令行工具，npm 包名 `openyida` | 本插件的「手」：所有真实操作都通过它执行 |
| **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）** | 本插件运行的宿主：带工具调用能力的 AI Agent 桌面端 | 提供工具注册、右侧栏、内置浏览器 |

关于 OpenYida 的能力边界，值得先知道两点：

- **官方 OpenAPI 只能操作「数据」**（表单实例、流程实例、审批任务、附件），元数据只有只读接口；**创建/修改应用与表单结构**只能用登录态的接口，OpenYida 封装的就是这条路。
- 它需要**你自己的宜搭登录态**（`openyida login`），不占用钉钉开放平台的授权包。

## 功能

### 1. 14 个 `yida_*` 工具

| 工具 | 类型 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `yida_status` | 只读 | CLI 版本、登录态、工作目录 —— 开工前先跑它 |
| `yida_org_list` | 只读 | 列出登录态可访问的组织 |
| `yida_org_switch` | 写入 | 切换本地登录组织（只改本地凭据指针，不动宜搭数据） |
| `yida_apps` | 只读 | 列应用。`scope`：`mine` / `admin`（我是管理员）/ `all`（我能访问的全部） |
| `yida_forms` | 只读 | 列应用下的表单/页面 |
| `yida_schema` | 只读 | 读表单 Schema（字段、fieldId、校验规则）—— **改表单前必做** |
| `yida_app_entry` | 只读 | 读平台登记的前端入口 / 管理台地址 |
| `yida_data_query` | 只读 | 查表单数据实例（分页） |
| `yida_urls` | 只读 | 推导页面地址；`open: true` 时请求右侧内置浏览器打开 |
| `yida_create_app` | 写入 | 建应用 |
| `yida_create_form` | 写入 | 建表单页（字段 JSON 定义，支持 19 种业务组件 + 分组） |
| `yida_update_form` | 写入 | 增量改已有表单（保留其它现有组件） |
| `yida_patch_form` | 写入 | 按 JSON Pointer 深合并改表单 |
| `yida_publish_page` | 写入 | 编译并发布自定义页面（`.canvas.jsx`） |

### 2. 右侧栏「宜搭工作台」

- 登录态徽标、CLI 来源；
- 口径切换：**我管理的** / **我能访问**；
- 应用列表 → 一键「打开（工作台）」「管理台」「表单」；
- 表单列表 → 打开表单页；
- 地址框：粘贴任意宜搭地址，直接在内置浏览器里打开；
- 后台轮询：AI 侧调用 `yida_urls { open: true }` 后，工作台会自动把页面开进内置浏览器。

> 内置浏览器是 DSH 桌面版自带的 Electron `<webview>`，能带登录态打开宜搭。
> 它**不向模型暴露页面操作能力**——本插件的分工是「AI 负责改，浏览器负责看」。

## 安装

**前置**：DSH 桌面版、Node.js ≥ 20、一个能登录宜搭的钉钉账号。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/pangxie985/dsh-desktop-yida.git
cd dsh-desktop-yida
node scripts/install.mjs
```

安装脚本做四件事（幂等，改前自动备份 `.bak-<时间戳>`）：

1. 在插件目录 `npm install openyida`（这样你不用全局装 CLI）；
2. 在 profile 的 `node_modules` 里建目录联接（Windows 用 junction，不需要管理员）；
3. 往 profile 的 `package.json` 写 `"dsh-desktop-yida": "link:<插件目录>"` 并加入 `dsh.profile.bundles`；
4. 最后才往 `cordis.patch.yml` 写挂载行。

> **顺序是有讲究的**：DSH 桌面版会热监听 profile 配置。如果配置先出现一个还解析不到的包名，加载器会失败甚至把宿主重启。所以脚本严格按「先让包可解析，再改配置」执行——这也是我自己踩过的坑。

**重启 DSH** 让 Host 半生效（会中断当前会话）。

其他用法：

```bash
node scripts/install.mjs --profile web   # 装到 web profile（注意：web 端侧栏不可用，见「兼容性」）
node scripts/install.mjs --uninstall     # 卸载
node scripts/install.mjs --skip-cli      # 不自动装 openyida（你自己管）
```

## 首次使用：登录宜搭

```bash
# 用插件目录里那份 CLI（推荐，版本和插件一起管）
node node_modules/openyida/bin/yida.js login

# 或者你已全局装过
openyida login
```

登录成功后，在 DSH 里让 AI 调 `yida_status`，看到 `loginStatus: "ok"` 就通了。
多组织账号可以 `yida_org_list` 看有哪些组织、`yida_org_switch` 切过去。

## 使用方法

### A. 直接对 AI 说人话（推荐）

| 你想做的事 | 这样说 |
|---|---|
| 盘点应用 | 「列出我是管理员的宜搭应用」 |
| 看结构 | 「读一下 APP_XXX 的表单列表」「把设备台账的 Schema 拉出来」 |
| 建应用 | 「新建一个叫『XX 管理』的宜搭应用」 |
| 建表单 | 「在 APP_XXX 建表单『客户登记』，字段：客户名称、客户编号、联系人手机、地址定位」 |
| 改表单 | 「给客户登记表加一个『是否重点客户』下拉字段（是/否）」 |
| 发布页面 | 「把这个页面发布到 APP_XXX / FORM-XXX」 |
| 看效果 | 「在右侧浏览器打开 APP_XXX 的工作台」 |

AI 会按固定节奏走：**读 → 改 → dry-run 给你看命令 → 你确认 → 写入 → 回读校验 → 打开给你看**。

### B. 右侧栏工作台

1. `Ctrl + Alt + B` 展开右侧栏（Web 版是 `Ctrl + Shift + B`）；
2. 在 guide 里选「**宜搭工作台**」；
3. 「我管理的 / 我能访问」切换口径，点应用上的「打开」即可在内置浏览器看到真实应用。

### C. 不经过 AI，直接用 CLI

```bash
node node_modules/openyida/bin/yida.js app-list --type managed
node node_modules/openyida/bin/yida.js list-forms APP_XXXXXXXX
node node_modules/openyida/bin/yida.js get-schema APP_XXXXXXXX FORM-XXXXXXXX --summary-json
node node_modules/openyida/bin/yida.js create-form create APP_XXXXXXXX "客户登记" fields.json
node node_modules/openyida/bin/yida.js data query form APP_XXXXXXXX FORM-XXXXXXXX --page 1 --size 20
```

### 一个真实的字段定义示例

建表单时传给 `yida_create_form` 的 `fieldsFile`：

```json
[
  { "type": "Divider", "title": "设备信息", "dividerType": "bold-with-thin" },
  { "type": "TextField", "label": "设备名称", "required": true, "placeholder": "请输入设备名称" },
  { "type": "TextField", "label": "设备编号", "required": true },
  { "type": "Divider", "title": "客户信息", "dividerType": "bold-with-thin" },
  { "type": "TextField", "label": "客户名称" },
  { "type": "TextField", "label": "客户编号" },
  { "type": "AddressField", "label": "设备定位" }
]
```

常用组件：`TextField` 单行文本、`TextareaField` 多行、`NumberField` 数字、`SelectField` 下拉、`RadioField` 单选、`CheckboxField` 多选、`DateField` 日期、`EmployeeField` 成员、`AddressField` 地址/定位、`AttachmentField` 附件、`ImageField` 图片、`TableField` 子表格、`Divider` 分组标题、`ColumnContainer` 分栏。
完整清单见 [OpenYida 字段速查](https://github.com/openyida/openyida/blob/main/yida-skills/references/field-and-url-reference.md)。

## 安全闸门

写入类工具必须**同时**满足两个条件才会真正执行：

1. 插件设置里 `allowRemoteWrites` 为真（默认开，可关死）；
2. 调用时显式传 `confirm: true`。

任何一条不满足，工具**不执行**，只回显将要运行的完整命令。所有写工具都支持 `dryRun: true`，先看命令再决定。

此外：

- `/yida/api/*` 只暴露只读接口，且只接受回环 Host（防 DNS rebinding）；
- 不做批量、无人值守的改造 —— 这类操作风险与合规成本都太高。

## 配置项

在 DSH 的插件设置里改（对应 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config`）：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `cliPath` | 空 | openyida 入口绝对路径；留空则依次找：插件自带 `node_modules` → `OPENYIDA_CLI` 环境变量 → `PATH` |
| `projectDir` | 空 | CLI 工作目录（生成的 `.cache/openyida` 产物落这里）；留空用宿主进程 cwd |
| `baseUrl` | 空 | 宜搭站点；**留空自动用当前登录站点**（企业专属站点不是 `www.aliwork.com`，强烈建议留空） |
| `allowRemoteWrites` | `true` | 关掉后所有写入工具一律拒绝 |
| `timeoutMs` | `180000` | 单次 CLI 调用超时 |
| `maxInlineBytes` | `24000` | 工具返回给模型的最大字符数 |

## 常见问题

**Q：`yida_apps` 返回 0 个应用，但我明明有应用？**
OpenYida 的 `app-list` 会硬编码 `creator=<我的 userId>`，只列「我自己创建的」。别人创建、而你是管理员的应用不会出现。
用 `yida_apps { scope: "admin" }`（我是管理员）或 `{ scope: "all" }`（我能访问的全部），右侧栏工作台也有对应切换。

**Q：生成的链接打不开 / 指向 `www.aliwork.com`？**
你的宜搭是专属站点（形如 `https://xxxxxx.aliwork.com`）。`baseUrl` 留空时插件会自动读登录站点；如果你手工填了 `baseUrl`，请改成自己的站点。

**Q：右侧栏找不到「宜搭工作台」？**
① 先在 GUI 里硬刷新一次（`Ctrl+Shift+R`）让 client 半加载；② 右侧栏默认是收起的，按 `Ctrl+Alt+B` 展开；③ 展开后在 guide / 新建标签里找。

**Q：改了代码什么时候生效？**
`lib/client.js`（client 半）会自动热加载；`lib/index.js`（Host 半）**必须重启 DSH**。

**Q：安装时报 `Cannot find module '@babel/standalone'`？**
OpenYida CLI 的依赖没装全。执行 `npm install --prefix . openyida` 后重试（`scripts/install.mjs` 默认会做）。

**Q：登录态过期？**
重新 `openyida login`。登录态存在用户目录（`%APPDATA%\openyida\auth`），与 DSH profile 无关，desktop / web 两个 profile 共用。

## 兼容性

| 环境 | 工具（Host 半） | 右侧栏（Client 半） | 内置浏览器看应用 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **DSH 桌面版**（0.2.x） | ✅ 实测通过 | ✅ | ✅（Electron `<webview>`） |
| DSH web profile | ⚠️ 理论可用，未实测 | ❌ 不可用 | ❌ 不可用 |

web 端不可用的原因不是本插件的问题，而是载体限制：

1. web profile 的 DSH 运行时（0.1.x）**没有**官方的 `dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right` / `dsh-client-ui-slots` 这套右侧栏包，web 端的右侧栏由生态插件 `dsh-better-sidebar` 提供（另一套 `ctx.betterSidebar.registerTab` API）；
2. web 版的内置浏览器是 **sandbox iframe**，而宜搭返回 `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`，浏览器直接拒绝嵌入。

所以 web 端建议只把它当「执行工具」用：AI 干活，结果用系统浏览器看。

平台：Windows 实测通过；macOS / Linux 未实测（路径与进程调用均使用 Node API，理论上可用，欢迎 PR 反馈）。

## 合规提醒（请先读）

- **OpenYida 不是钉钉官方授权工具**。它通过**登录态**调用宜搭的接口，其中「创建/修改应用与表单结构」走的是内部接口路径。
- 《钉钉服务协议》第八条（软件使用规范）包含「通过非钉钉公司开发、授权的第三方软件、插件、外挂、系统，登录或使用软件及服务」的禁止性条款；《宜搭服务使用规则》另有系统配置、反向工程等条款。**是否适用、如何解释，认定权在钉钉**。
- 因此建议：**只对你自己有权限的应用使用；写入前保留确认；不要在公司内部分发、运营这类工具；不要把批量导出组织数据当作常规操作。**
- 用到生产环境前，请让公司合规/法务确认，或向宜搭官方书面确认。
- **这不是法律意见**，条款以钉钉官网最新版本为准。

## 开发

```
dsh-desktop-yida/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 声明
├── cordis.patch.yml      # profile 挂载行
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # Host 半：14 个工具 + /yida/api/* 只读路由
│   ├── client.js         # Client 半：window.__ModuleLoader__ bundle（宜搭工作台）
│   ├── yida-cli.js       # CLI 定位 / 参数编译 / JSON 解析 / URL 推导
│   ├── yida-auth.js      # 登录态与只读接口桥接（应用列表口径、站点识别）
│   └── schema.js         # defineTool / defineConfig 同形实现（零外部依赖）
├── scripts/install.mjs   # 安装 / 卸载（步骤顺序有讲究）
├── tools/                # 排查脚本：组织清单、应用口径对比
└── test/                 # 58 项测试 + 假 CLI + 真实 CLI 冒烟
```

```bash
npm test        # 58 项：参数/URL/JSON、Host 工具与路由、client bundle 契约
npm run smoke   # 用真实 openyida CLI 跑只读命令（不写任何数据）
```

**加一个新工具**：在 `lib/yida-cli.js` 的 `buildArgs()` 里加一个 operation，再在 `lib/index.js` 的 tools 数组里用 `readTool(...)` / `writeTool(...)` 注册即可；测试里补一条参数编译用例。

### 为什么不用 bundler

client 半是手写的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 单文件，`require('react')` 由宿主的平台模块表解析。省掉构建链，改完直接生效。

## 插件市场 / 索引

**仓库被 fork 或 star 不会被任何市场自动收录。** DSH 的插件市场是「索引源驱动」的，需要主动登记：

### 官方市场（DSH 自带，「插件 → 发现」）

官方市场读的是**索引源 URL**（format 1 的 JSON）。本仓库已经准备好一份，并用官方校验器 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` 验证通过：

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pangxie985/dsh-desktop-yida/main/market/index.json
```

添加方式：

1. 插件页 → **发现** → **添加索引源**；
2. 粘贴上面的 URL，保存；
3. 列表里就会出现「**宜搭 AI 开发（dsh-desktop-yida）**」，点安装。

> 索引里的安装源是 **git + commit 固定**（`git+https://github.com/...#<40位 SHA>`），所以装到的是可复现的版本，不会跟着 `main` 漂移。
> 发新版本时重新跑 `node scripts/build-market-index.mjs` 更新 commit，再提交即可。

### 第三方市场 dshmarket

[dshmarket](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) 的目录来自**它自己发布的 npm 包里的 `plugins.json`**（见其 `catalog-npm.ts`）。想被它收录需要：

1. 把插件**发布到 npm**（它优先安装「经仓库验证的 npm 包」）；
2. 向它的 catalog 仓库提 PR，在 `plugins.json` 里加一条条目。

### 让安装体验最好：发布到 npm

目前索引用的是 git 源，安装时 pnpm 会拉整仓源码。如果发布到 npm：

```bash
npm publish          # 之后可把 market/index.json 的 source 改成 { "type": "npm" }
```

这样安装只需数秒、无需本地构建，也更容易被第三方市场收录。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-git-control-flow

Generative Git workflow card for the DSH Web conversation: a strip that grows out of the composer into a branch graph with conflicts, checks and a merge state — driven by real Git facts and the session log.

## Status

**Step 1 · skeleton.** The bundle files are written and the Client module contract is covered by a local smoke test. Installation into the profile is **not yet granted**, so the dock seat is not live-verified.

| Step | Content | State |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bundle skeleton + dock seat | written, install pending approval |
| 2a | Git read layer: `runGit`, porcelain v2 / numstat / log parsers, status snapshot | done, 8 real-Git tests |
| 2b | `git_flow` tool + `gitFlow` projection + `/git-flow` command | done, 15 offline tests |
| 3 | Card rendering from the Host-computed view model | done, 30 tests; visual pending install |
| 4 | Motion: card reveal, row stagger, text scramble, number pop, reduced-motion | done, 33 tests; visual pending |
| 5 | Writes: `stage` + `commit`, each behind an approval request | done, 47 tests; merge/resolve pending |
| 5b | Repository discovery one level down when the session directory is not a repo | done, 54 tests |
| 5c | Collapse/expand toggle, remembered per session in localStorage | done, 54 tests |
| 6 | Checks mapping, conflict popover, push (opt-in) | pending |

## Layout

```
package.json        bundle manifest (dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client)
cordis.patch.yml    one inserted row: git-control-flow
index.js            Host half: harness imports only, delegates to lib/flow/register
client.js           Client half: conversation.input.dock strip
lib/git/exec.mjs    argv-only git runner (no shell, bounded, timed out)
lib/git/parse.mjs   porcelain v2 / numstat / log parsers (pure)
lib/git/status.mjs  whole-value GitStatusSnapshot reader
lib/flow/contract.mjs  tool name, command name, parameter spec
lib/flow/state.mjs     gitFlow state, pure fold, structural validation
lib/flow/schema.mjs    ZodType-compatible subset (parse/safeParse), zero deps
lib/flow/projection.mjs session projection definition + identity wire view
lib/flow/register.mjs   registration body, injectable for offline tests
lib/flow/render.mjs     snapshot → compact text (model result, command)
lib/flow/view.mjs       Host-computed card model (phases, rows, validation)
locale/{en,zh}.json Plugin Manager display metadata
icon.svg            original artwork
test/               real-Git status tests, projection/register tests, client smoke test
```

## Development notes

- Full design, frame-by-frame video analysis, decision log and step-by-step journal:
  `DSH-GIT-FLOW-DEVELOPMENT.md`, kept outside this repository next to it.
- Plain JavaScript client module: no build step, no Harness Client package imports. React comes from the browser module table.
- Visible text goes through the Client locale service; styles are registered once in `apply` and removed with the client run.
- Dock geometry mirrors the host's own dock strip so the card lines up with the composer in both themes.

## Install

> A locally linked bundle must declare every Harness package it imports under `peerDependencies`; the profile's module-resolution router only redirects an import for a linked root when that root declares the name. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` is declared for this reason. `engines.dsh` pins the compatible runtime range.

Target: the `web` DSH profile, as a local bundle whose patch inserts the `git-control-flow` row. The install itself escalates plugin management to full access, so it waits for explicit approval; nothing is installed yet.

```bash
# once approved, from the DSH session:
# plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle",
#                  target: "<absolute path to this checkout>" }
```

## Local checks

```bash
npm run check   # node --check across both halves, the git layer and the flow layer
npm test        # 30 tests: real-Git status, view model, projection/register wiring, client contract
```

# Task Board Plugin for DeepSeek Harness

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-agent-board)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-agent-board)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dw/dsh-agent-board.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-agent-board)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/node/v/dsh-agent-board.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-agent-board)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-agent-board)](https://github.com/PPawnsir/task-board-plugin/blob/main/LICENSE)
![category](https://img.shields.io/badge/awesome--dsh--plugin-workflow-blue)

智能看板插件 — agent 团队的持久台账与治理层：把「派发 → 执行 → 验收 → 度量 → 复盘」跑成全链路闭环，每一张卡都是可审计、可度量的长期资产。

## 定位

**dsh-agent-board 是 agent 团队的持久台账与治理层——看板只是界面，内核是「派发 → 执行 → 验收 → 度量 → 复盘」的全链路闭环。** 它与「一次性组队、跑完即散」的冲锋型编排器、「人建卡、agent 认领、人逐张验收」的手工看板不是一个代际：

- **持久台账**：任务卡是长期资产。完成 / 驳回 / 歧义裁决 / 验收结论 / Token 消耗 / 自测指南，每一笔都落账留痕，看板文件即审计底稿；卸载不删数据，重启自动继承。
- **池化 Worker + 独立 Verifier**：执行与验收分离——Worker 负责动手（可续跑，续跑只认新增产出），Verifier 独立复跑验收脚本、以实证为准，不听 Worker 的一面之词。
- **独立验收**：`acceptance` 硬性脚本命令由 Worker 实跑、Verifier 独立复跑；结论分通过 / 驳回并逐条给证据。人只看该看的——风险队列「待你过目」把该亲自确认的卡推到眼前，其余交给机器闭环。
- **可运维度量栈**：记分卡（模型表现 / 质量趋势 / 驳回聚类）、运行时健康自检、异常驱动审视（风险队列 / 质量异动告警 / 批次摘要）三层，让成本与质量从「感觉」变成「数字」。

> **流水线归机器，审计台归人。** 我们不造「跑完就散」的冲锋队，也不做「人逐张盯着验收」的手工看板；我们的信念只有三条：**验收独立复跑、人只看该看的、数据沉淀成资产**。别人负责冲锋，agent-board 负责记账与验收——互补，不对抗。

### 适合谁 / 什么时候用

- **长期多任务并行**：一个会话里几十张卡、有依赖有先后、还不断追加新需求——需要一份不随会话结束而消失的台账，而不是每次重开都从零描述。
- **关心成本与质量趋势**：想看清哪个模型在什么场景更省、驳回率在涨还是跌、哪些文件反复成为锁热点——需要记分卡与趋势，而不是拍脑袋。
- **不想逐张审卡**：接受「独立复跑 + 风险队列兜底」的治理方式——机器把「该我亲自看」的卡筛出来，其余信任验收闭环。
- **缺一层治理而非缺一个编排器**：已有冲锋型的团队 / 编排工具，缺的正是「记账、验收、度量、复盘」这一层——agent-board 补上它。

## 安装

### 前置条件

- DeepSeek Harness（dsh）已安装并能正常启动：`dsh --profile web`
- Node.js ≥ 22（与 dsh 运行时一致）

### 版本兼容性（先按宿主选插件版本）

| 宿主 DSH 版本 | 应装插件版本 | 原因 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **≥ 0.2.0**（含 rc） | **≥ 1.3.0（必须）** | 0.2.0 起宿主在启动/安装时强制校验 peerDependencies，区间不含 0.2.0 的包**直接拒绝激活**（路由不挂载、面板不出现）。1.3.0 声明 `^0.1.7 \|\| 0.2.0-rc.2 \|\| ^0.2.0`——注意 semver 预发布不命中宽区间，`0.2.0-rc.2` 必须显式枚举。运行时 API（subagents/systemPrompt/agents/uiWorkspace.openSession/sessions/v4 日志格式）在 0.2.0 全部兼容，已过 0.2.0-rc.2 实测（E2E 23+8 断言全绿） |
| **0.1.7 ~ 0.1.7-x**（含 rc） | **≥ 1.2.2（必须）** | 0.1.7 会话日志升级为 format v4：插件消息 `source.kind` 必须是生产者自有 kind。1.2.1 及更早会在**任务完成/阻塞回执**落盘时抛 `SessionFormatError: format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind`，并连带使主窗口当前轮次失败（表现为「本轮运行失败」）；同时「跳转会话」因宿主移除 `sessions.open` 而失效（控制台 `sessionsSvc.open is not a function`），卡片活动心跳读不到 v4 日志（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`） |
| 0.1.5-rc.1 ~ 0.1.6 | ≤ 1.2.1 | 1.2.2 起按 0.1.7 协议编写（v4 source kind、`uiWorkspace.openSession` 跳转），旧宿主未做回归验证，建议停留 1.2.1 |

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agent-board@latest   # 0.1.7+/0.2.x 宿主（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agent-board@1.2.1    # 0.1.5/0.1.6 宿主
```

> 从 ≤1.2.1 升到 ≥1.2.2 必须重启 DSH（host 端代码在启动时加载；1.2.2 之前的老版本还有一个路由残留 bug：禁用/启用热重载会撞 `duplicate exact route`，只能重启恢复，1.2.2 已修复）。

### 从插件市场安装（推荐）

已发布至 npm 官方 registry（[dsh-agent-board](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-agent-board)）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agent-board
# 重启 dsh 生效
dsh --profile web
```

### 从源码安装（开发/调试）

```sh
git clone https://github.com/PPawnsir/task-board-plugin.git
dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库绝对路径>/packages/dsh-agent-board
# 重启 dsh
```

### 验证安装

1. 启动日志无 `plugin tree failed to load`
2. 打开任意会话，标题栏出现 **智能看板** 按钮（Lucide 线性图标）
3. RPC 路由可用：

```sh
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-agent-board \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"method":"get-tasks","args":{"sessionId":"<sessionId>"}}'
```

返回 JSON 即正常；405 空 body 说明路由未挂载。

### 升级

```sh
# 市场版
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agent-board@latest
# 源码版
git pull
# 两者都需重启 dsh
```

### 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-agent-board
# 重启 dsh
```

> 看板数据存在 `~/.dsh/tasks-<sessionId>.json`，卸载不删数据。
>
> - **归属**：看板文件按**会话**分文件，同时在文件里记 `ownerCwd`（创建该看板的会话工作区路径，取不到则省略该字段）——`~/.dsh/tasks-*.json` 每个文件是一块看板，`list-boards` 全局视图可看到本机所有板。
> - **重启继承**：DSH 重启后同一会话的根 id 可能漂移，此时新 id 没有对应文件——若同工作区（`ownerCwd` 严格相等）存在**唯一**「原主已不在 `agents.roots()`」的看板，则自动继承：文件重命名为新 id、文件内 `ownerSession` 改写为新 id、`console.error` 留一行 `[task-board] 继承看板 <旧sid> → <新sid>`；**多个候选一律不自动接管**（记一行日志后按空板处理，防误合并，旧板仍可在 `list-boards` 全局视图里看到）。
> - **写盘保护**：落盘走 临时文件+rename 原子写（EPERM/EBUSY 退避重试）；瞬时读失败/坏文件隔离后返回的空板**禁止回写**（防一个"读不到"的瞬间把看板覆成空板），坏文件隔离为 `.corrupt-<时间戳>` 留档不丢数据。

## 数据安全

看板数据（`~/.dsh/tasks-<sessionId>.json`）是本插件唯一的持久化状态，按三层防线保证数据不丢、事故可见：

- **原子写盘（防撕裂写）**：落盘一律「写临时文件 → `fsync` → `rename` 覆盖目标」——`rename` 在同分区是原子的，进程在写盘中途被强杀时磁盘上最多残留一个 `.tmp` 残件，看板本体永远不会是截断的半个 JSON。Windows 上 `rename` 覆盖已存在目标原生支持（实测直接覆盖成功），仅当目标被并发读句柄/Defender/索引器瞬时占用（`EPERM`/`EBUSY`/`EACCES`/`ENOTEMPTY`）时做有限退避重试；重试耗尽仍失败则降级「先 `unlink` 目标再 `rename`」并留日志——绝不丢整板。
- **腐坏隔离可见化（不再静默）**：加载时若 JSON 解析失败（撕裂写/重启打断导致文件中部夹杂另一版本残片），坏文件改名 `.corrupt-<时间戳>` 留档隔离（防反复 poison），同时在「架构健康」区亮一条 **err 级红条**（`healthHints`）提示「看板数据文件腐坏已隔离，历史在 `.corrupt-<ts>`，可联系恢复」，并向 owner 会话推送通知——数据不丢，也不再静默从空板重启。
- **自动 salvage（截断抢救）**：隔离前先尝试抢救——从首字节起截到第一个完整 JSON 值（`JSON.parse` 报错 `position` 截断法，与人工恢复同款手法），成功则以抢救出的完整板为底自动写回继续（`healthHints` 红条记「已抢救保留 N 张卡，丢弃撕裂残片」），失败才回退空板。两种情况下原始文件都留档 `.corrupt-<ts>`，可随时人工恢复。

## 功能总览

**核心能力一页速览**（`★` 为 v1.7.5–1.8.4 新栈）：

- **看板**：六列状态流、拖拽 / 多选批量 / 文本·优先级·标签筛选、归档留档、会话隔离
- **派发**：一次性 Worker / 独立 Verifier、依赖调度（DFS 环检测）、touches 文件级排他、可续跑 Worker、Team 托管、**spawn 落闸锁内重验**（spawnGateOk：claim 占位与落闸决策读同一把锁的同一份快照，terminate/dependsOn 后补 落在 spawn 在途窗口即弃权——竞态与后补依赖双双根治）、**高优干预分态**（intervene 无活跃 run 时区分「续跑窗口，干预随续跑注入」与「真无 run」，返回体带 state 字段）、**建卡派发预警**（将自动派发时 lintWarnings 瞬态提示「约 1s 内被领取，想占位请 draft:true」）、**宿主 spawn API 双兼容**（v0.2.1 宿主把 `subagents.start/startContinuable` 统一重构为 `startActivation(spec)`——能力探测自动选路：新契约按 `delivery` 语义分发（continuable=`parent` 结算留言 / 一次性=`caller` 只回 result），Activation 适配旧 run 形状下游零改动；老宿主逐字走旧双路径）+ **continuable 结算兜底臂**（`activation.result` 在子会话被宿主拆除时落定即接失败结算——rate-limit/模型崩溃的死子不再挂到硬超时）
- **验收治理** `★`：硬性验收脚本独立复跑、驳回全量带回重派、Verifier 自测指南（userTest）、风险队列「待你过目」、验收时序防护（Verifier 在场时主窗口抢批需显式 `force:true`；有活跃 run 的卡禁止归档；Verifier 迟到结论落 `lateVerdict` 留痕+直投告警）、**迟到 verdict 三保险**（①入参校验：`verdict` 非 approved/rejected 拒收并返回重调指引——漏带字段不再被当驳回落账；②通知分态：approved 迟到=「✅ 迟到复核·全过追认」notice 级，🚨「迟到驳回」只留给真 rejected；③指纹去重：同 taskId+by+verdict 只投一次，重复落账零重复通知）
- **度量** `★`：Token 消耗（总量 / 有效 / 缓存读，按模型·按任务·按日）+ 记分卡（模型表现 / 质量趋势 / 驳回聚类）
- **可运维性** `★`：运行时健康自检（派发冻结 / 结算停滞告警）、异常驱动审视（风险队列 / 质量异动告警 / 批次摘要）、起草 lint、数据安全（原子写盘 / 腐坏隔离 / 自动 salvage）、**僵尸 run 留档清扫**（host 重启后「落定卡上的 running 无 endedAt 留档」在派发周期自动关账 `stale-closed` + 清认领位，归档门禁不再被幻影 run 永久拦截）、**子会话生命周期收口**（一次性 run 落定/迟到 verdict 落账后主动 interrupt 子会话——「结算≠停止」空转根治；continuable 收紧为「续跑位真在本 child 手上」才豁免，残影 Worker 无处藏身）、**terminate 三保险**（no-rec 也按认领位盲杀补刀 + interrupt 失败 err 级可见化 + `hold:true` 原子「终止+转手动」）、**配置审计**（set-board-config 成功写入落板级 configLog {key,from,to,actor,at} 截尾 50 条；模型下拉两段式选中≠保存）
- **学习反馈**：候选教训信号 → 主窗口沉淀（零耦合，不碰任何笔记 / 记忆工具 API）

以下各节是完整规格。

### 看板 UI

- 会话标题栏「智能看板」按钮 → 顶部抽屉面板（看板 / 团队 / 仪表盘三视图）
- 面板右上角「＋ 新建任务」：表单弹层填标题/描述/优先级/管线/touches/依赖多选/验收脚本，Team 托管默认存为草稿（提交走 create-task RPC，成功即刷新、失败表单内联报错）
- 新建任务弹层为视口级 overlay（fixed 全屏遮罩 + 限高 80vh + 字段区内部滚动 + 按钮区吸底常驻，不再被看板抽屉裁切）；卡片「当前动作」行摘要化为「工具名 + 关键参数」（40 字符内有意义断点截断，悬停 title 看 host 原文），不再展示裸 JSON
- 六列状态流：草稿 → 待办 → 进行中 → 验证中 → 已完成 → 阻塞（空板也统一渲染六列骨架 + 引导 CTA：右上角「＋ 新建任务」或对话一句 task_create 建第一张卡）
- 读路径 error 防线：get-tasks 返回 {error} 或网络抖动时保留现有卡片与设置（不再静默清空全板），面板头部下方出非阻断红色错误条，下次刷新成功自动消失
- 耗时口径三分离：待办/草稿卡显「⏳ 等待 N」（创建→被领取），执行后显「⏱ 执行 N」（被领取→完成，tooltip 写清口径）——排队时间不再混进"耗时"
- 拖拽流转、多选批量操作（带一步撤销）、文本/优先级/标签筛选；卡片键盘可达（Tab 聚焦 + Enter/Space 开详情），详情页附「流转到」按钮组（状态迁移的键盘替代通道，失败内联回显）
- 归档区：时间倒序 + 排序选择器 + 纵向滚动
- Esc 逐级关闭（详情 → 看板 → 面板）
- **详情面板操作消歧**：破坏性操作（取消任务 / 删除）独立成「危险操作」区（红色虚线分隔 + a11y 分组 + confirm 预警），与表单按钮（保存/发布）视觉分层；头部右上 ✕ 显性关闭钮——「取消」不再被误读为「关面板」
- **fork/迁移会话同样有看板**：根判定用会话头 `delegationDepth`（fork/seed 会话 depth=0 认根；真子代理 depth≥1 才隐藏看板入口），不再误把带 parentSession 的 fork 当子代理
- 全部结构性图标为 Lucide 线性 SVG（`currentColor` 跟随主题，浅深色自适应）
- **界面缩放档位**（⚙️ 设置弹层「界面」小节，90% / 100%（默认）/ 110% / 125% / 150% 五档）：面板根容器 CSS `zoom` 等比缩放（字体/图标/间距一并放大，只影响本面板、不碰宿主页面），选中即时生效并 `localStorage` 本地记忆（键 `dsh-agent-board-ui-zoom`）

### 仪表盘（Token 消耗）

- 仪表盘视图新增「Token 消耗」区：本看板累计**有效 / 缓存读 / 合计**三分量 + 输入 / 输出（缓存写非零时一并展示）拆分、按模型分布条形图、任务消耗 **Top 8**（标题可点击直达该任务详情，title 附「有效 N / 缓存读 M」拆分）；大数字为**今日总量**（含缓存读，本地日口径，无日账则显示 0，旁附「其中有效 X」小字对照，有效消耗详见悬浮 title）、旁附「累计（本看板）」三分量小字，下方「近 7 天」迷你条形按日展示近 7 天**总量**（今天高亮，title 补有效对照，7 天全为 0 时不渲染）；进行中的卡片右上角显示本任务已累计消耗（`⛁ 数字`）；区底固定口径 caption：累计 / Top 8 仅看板派发的 run 消耗，主窗口行并列不混入
- 口径要点：**有效消耗 = 输入 + 输出 + 缓存写（不含缓存读）**；总量 = 有效 + 缓存读。**主显口径翻转（`task-muxnqunk`，用户 2026-10-07 裁决「算总的吧」，推翻 `task-muwq9u04` 的有效主显）**：Token 区**主数字均为总量口径（含缓存读）**——今日大数字 / 近 7 天柱 / 按模型分布 / Top 8 / 主窗口行一律显总量，有效消耗退居悬浮 title 或次要小字；旧口径日（`e=null`）的「今日显 — / 矮灰柱」防护顺势退役（总量恒有值，正常画柱，悬浮注明有效不可知）。**不动的**：「模型表现」「质量趋势」区保持有效口径（效率指标语义），报告导出分列口径不动。实证背景：本板累计 10.3M 里缓存读占 9.7M（94%）——总量与有效的差额一眼可在累计三分量与悬浮里对照
- **主数字口径统一**（`task-muxnqunk` 翻转版，替代 `task-muwq9u04`）：**按模型分布行与任务消耗 Top 8 行的主数字一律为总量**（含缓存读；模型取 host 的 `byModel`，任务取 `topTasks[].total`），有效消耗（`byModelEff` 模型有效分摊 / `topTasks[].effective`）进悬浮 title——与「今日」「近 7 天」同口径；老 host 缺 `byModelEff` 或老卡无五分量留账时 title 标「有效不可知」（口径不伪造）

### 存储清理（已结算会话）

- **看板内建「已结算会话清理」**（`task-mv2131cz`，用户指令「这个清理可以做到看板上」）：DSH 宿主无会话删除 API（归档=执行门禁不删数据），看板是唯一知道「哪些会话账已结清」的组件——清理只能长在看板上。仪表盘新增「**存储清理**」区：「预览可清理会话」按钮 → 展示可删会话数 + 预估释放空间 + 按卡分组明细 + 跳过项与理由（**只读不删**；体积估算优先读宿主 `SessionPersistenceSnapshot.sizeBytes`，快照缺省时回退目录遍历）；「清理」按钮**二次确认**后真删（删除不可恢复，token 账早已记入卡片、删除不影响任何统计），完成后报告「已释放 N / 跳过 M 及理由」
- **可删判定：卡龄主闸 + 三底闸**（host `lib/cleanup.mjs` 纯函数）：只删**本板 runs[] 关联的会话 id**，且 **主闸 = 卡龄**——所属卡 `status=archived` 且 `archivedAt` 距今 ≥ `cleanupRetentionDays`（板级设置项，默认 **7 天**、可配 1-90，回收与归档生命周期对齐）；**三底闸永留**——① `outcome` 已落定（非 `running`）② 会话当前不活跃（不在 `ctx.agents` 活跃树 / 非本会话血统）③ 路径安全（id 白名单 + `rm` 前 `isWithin` 再验）——任一解析不确定即跳过并计入理由（宁漏勿错删）。`continuable`/`usageRecorded` 两道旧闸已撤：归档满保留天数即视为账本封存、续跑意愿过期（恢复待办时旧会话已被删走，既有「冷复活失败→回落新 spawn」路径承接，零新逻辑）
- **删除范围**：会话日志目录 `~/.dsh/sessions/<bucket>/<id>/`（`fs.rm` recursive）+ projcache 缓存 `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`；**路径逃逸双闸防护**：① 会话 id 白名单 `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`（含 `../`、`/`、`\` 一律拒）② `rm` 前再验目标绝对路径仍在 sessions/projcache 桶内（`path.relative` 判定）。**注册表索引残留**：`~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache.json`（宿主托管的 `version/seq` 结构）**不清理**——只是元数据索引，残留条目不占会话日志体积，宿主自会 GC；每次清理写 `board.cleanupLog` 留痕（时间/操作者/删除数/释放字节/会话 id 清单，上限 50 条）

### 学习反馈（候选教训信号 → 主窗口沉淀）

- **信号源架构（零耦合）**：看板只产「候选教训**信号**」，不做**存储**——不调用任何笔记/记忆工具的 API、不写任何外部文件、也不知道教训最终被存到哪；用不用、存进哪个工具（如 `note_search` / `note_manage`）完全由主窗口 agent 自己决定
- **自动生成候选**（两处触发）：① Verifier 驳回 → 一条 `lesson-candidate` 消息（场景 / 错误做法 / 来源）；② 主窗口裁决 Worker 歧义 → 一条 `lesson-candidate` 消息（场景 / 疑问 / 裁决结论）。同一事件按「同时间戳 / 同内容前缀」轻量判重只落一条，且不写 `history` 流转记录（不刷屏）
- **详情页「沉淀」按钮**：把该条候选教训经 `push-lesson` RPC followup 给主窗口 agent（提示语写明「请用你可用的笔记/记忆工具沉淀，或评估后忽略」），推送成功后按钮变「✅ 已推送」置灰
- **软召回引导**：Worker prompt 与 Team 模式提示词都会加一句「开工前如环境装有笔记/记忆类工具（如 note_search），先检索相关历史教训再动手」（Team 档另外提醒把检索到的教训写进任务的 `contextNotes`）
- **开关 `feedbackEnabled`**（⚙️ 设置区「学习反馈」，默认**开**）：关掉后不生成候选、prompt 不提软召回、详情页候选卡片与「沉淀」按钮整个不渲染；老看板文件没有该字段 → 读路径自动补 `true`（与升级前行为一致）
- **两插件完全独立**：`dsh-agent-board` 与笔记类插件（如 `dsh-notes-plugin`）之间没有任何依赖、服务调用或文件直写——看板只发一条 followup 文本，怎么用由主窗口 agent 决定

### 任务模型

```
draft → pending → in-progress → verifying → resolved → archived
                     ↓              ↑
                  blocked ←────── reject
```

- **草稿态（draft）**：创建时可先进草稿，补全描述/依赖后再发布，杜绝"半成品被派发"
- **依赖调度**：`dependsOn` 声明依赖（DFS 环检测），依赖全部完成后才会被派发，串行链路自动编排
- **管线分档**：`full`（执行+验证）/ `work`（只做不验）/ `direct`（不进池，主窗口直接处理），创建时按规则自动分类、可手动覆盖
- **硬性验收**：`acceptance` 字段写验收脚本命令，Worker 必须实际运行、Verifier 必须独立复跑
- **git 纪律红线**：Worker prompt 写死禁止还原命令（`git checkout` / `git restore` / `git reset --hard` / `git clean` 等——会冲掉并行 Worker 与你自己的未提交在途编辑）；只改自己写的文件、别人改了别的文件与你无关，确实需要干净基线时走歧义上报（`board_report` kind=escalate）由主窗口裁决；**提交只允许精确路径 `git add`**（本卡 `touches` 声明的文件，或逐一列出明确改过的文件路径），禁止 `git add -A` / `git add .` / `git add 目录`——并行 Worker 共享暂存区，宽泛 add 会把别卡在途编辑卷进 commit（实证 n-mv6xntg1p6i5：三起暂存吞并）
- **大文件交付纪律**：Worker prompt 写死分块写入指引——单文件交付预估 >8KB（或 spec 含全量文案/长代码）时禁止单次 `write` 写入全量（单次超长输出会撞模型输出上限、上下文耗尽零产出），先 `write` 落主体骨架、再用 `edit` 追加续块（每块 ≤4KB）逐块落地
- **前轮半成品提示**：卡片 runs[] 含已落定 worker run 时，Worker prompt 追加「先 `git status` 看工作区有无未提交半成品，能续作就续作，别盲目从零」——重发/重派场景的旧产物先盘点再决定
- **文件级排他**：`touches` 声明本任务要改的文件/glob（如 `["src/**", "README.md"]`）；持有文件锁的任务（`in-progress`/`verifying`）与候选 touches 重叠就跳过本轮（卡片显示 `🔒 等文件释放`，详情页列出在等谁），**锁随工作态**：状态流转到已完成（`resolved`）即放锁，`cancelled`/归档同样不再持锁（归档回归纯收纳动作、不再是释放点）——锁只护「正在写」的阶段，「验收后-提交前」的窗口期由主窗口「回执到即提交」纪律 + 史诗 post-hook 承接，不用长持锁把整批串行化。避免并行 Worker 改同一批文件互踩；手动「派发」遇到冲突会列出冲突任务，确认后才以 `force` 越权派发
- **里程碑进展通道**：Worker 每完成一个可验证的里程碑，可调用 `board_report`（`kind: "progress"`，`question` 写一行进展摘要 ≤200 字符）上报——进行中的卡片显示「📈 最近进展 · 相对时间」（覆盖式只留最新一条），详情页消息流保留全部 progress 条目
- **防表演式汇报**：进展契约只写在 Worker prompt 里、且要求「有实际产物/结论才报」（禁止定时汇报）；progress **静默不通知主窗口**（不进回执聚合），也不写 `history` 流转记录，避免刷屏
- **子任务**：父子层级 + 上下文继承 + 父任务自动流转 + 级联归档（僵尸态出清：`archive-task` 对「无活跃 run 的 in-progress」——典型如被 parentKick 推进后子任务已全部归档的史诗——直接放行，有活跃 run 的仍拒）；**归档子任务仍计入史诗进度并在详情留档可见**——进度分子口径 `settled = resolved | cancelled | archived`、分母也含归档，归档一张子卡不会再让史诗进度从 `0/10` 退化成 `0/9`（进度只增不减），全归档的父卡也照常显示徽章；详情子任务清单不排归档行（灰化 + 行尾「已归档」徽章 + 沉底排序，点击仍可进子卡看留档）
- **死会话零打扰**：15s 派发心跳对无活 root 的会话板直接跳过（不读盘/不写盘/零日志，会话重开后自动恢复派发）；`create-task` 拒绝不完整 sessionId（防裸短 id 建出幻影板）
- **面板轮询条件请求 + 渲染短路**：`get-tasks` 响应附 `tasksHash`；客户端轮询带上轮 hash 作 `ifHash`，host 比对一致时返回 `{unchanged:true}` 轻量响应（**不含 tasks 全量**——轮询载荷从 1.34MB 级降到 KB 级，usage/healthHints/池状态等轻量聚合照常返回），前端保留 `state.tasks` 不动并跳过重渲染；hash 不一致 / 不带 `ifHash` / `includeArchived` 一律全量返回（老客户端零回归）
- **看板抽屉稳定性（isRoot 持久语义 + 蝶变防抖）**：`isRoot` 判定改读**持久 parentSession**（根会话=无父）——休眠根会话（有板有卡但无活 agent）也算 root，入口不再分钟级消失；子代理会话（parentSession 指向父）恒不显示入口。客户端防抖仍保留兜底：已确认 root 的会话需**连续 3 次（≈9s）false** 才收起抽屉（会话生命周期内「曾确认 true」粘滞），看板不再在生成状态切换时突然消失；从未确认 root 的子代理会话仍即时隐藏入口，保护语义不变
  - 卡片识别层：父卡显示「📦 史诗 · settled/total」徽章 + 3px 迷你进度条（`settled = resolved | cancelled | archived`，total 同口径含归档；有在跑子任务时附「▸ 在跑：标题」行）；子卡标题下显示「↳ 父任务标题」；依赖未满足的待办卡底部灰字「⛓ 等待「依赖标题」」（childStats 由 host 现算，缺字段一律不渲染）
  - 详情父子区块：父卡详情列子任务清单（状态色点 + 标题，**含已归档留档**——归档行灰化 + 行尾「已归档」徽章并沉底，点击直达子卡详情，标题行汇总 settled/total）；子卡详情顶行「↳ 史诗：父标题」点击回跳父卡
- **可选 hooks（史诗可选点位：前置/后置各是一次真实 agent 运行）**：`epic.hooks = { pre: { enabled, prompt, state, runId }, post: 同构 }`——**前置**让子任务具备开跑条件（串行闸门：未完成前该史诗的子任务一张都不派），**后置**把这批活收口（全部子任务了结后跑一遍，完成后史诗才转验证中）；prompt 只给薄框架契约，具体动作由 hook agent **自行决策**，**吃不准就走歧义上报**（失败即转阻塞等人裁决：重试/跳过/放弃，不自动重跑）。hook run 记在 `epic.runs[]`（role `hook-pre`/`hook-post`），卡片带相位徽章（`⏳ 前置准备中` / `🧪 收尾中` / `⚠️ hook 失败待裁决`，无 hooks 的老卡零渲染），详情页 hooks 区可编辑 enabled+prompt、查看 state/耗时并跳转 run 会话、失败一键跳裁决区；**hooks 仅主窗口可设**（工具与 RPC 双通道门禁），commit/push 不入任何默认形态
- **删除通道（真删，无 undo）**：`delete-task` RPC（卡片 hover 垃圾桶按钮 / 详情页「删除」按钮，均先 `confirm('删除不可恢复，确认删除「标题」？')`）+ `batch-op op='delete'`（多选模式底部「批量删除」，同样 confirm）。状态门禁：**草稿/待办/阻塞可删**；进行中/验证中拒绝并提示先用 `terminate-agent` 终止（避免在跑的 run 变孤儿）；已完成/取消引导改用归档（`archive-task`，留档可检索）；有**未归档子任务**时拒删（防 `parentId` 悬空破坏父任务自动流转）；已归档任务幂等返回 ok。是真删（从 `tasks` 数组移除），因此**不产生 `batch-undo` 撤销快照**（批量条对 delete 不显示「↩️ 撤销」），删除操作在 host 端 `console.error` 留一行日志便于溯源
- **任务粒度建议**：单任务 **10~30 分钟**可独立完成为甜区；预计超过 30 分钟的大任务先建一张 **epic 父卡**（`pipeline: direct`，不进池派发），再挂若干 10~30 分钟的子任务（`task_create` 传 `parentId=父卡 id`，有先后顺序用 `dependsOn` 串联），子任务全部完成后父卡自动流转（`checkParentAuto`）——`task_create` 工具描述与 Team 模式提示词都写了这条契约；**容器卡结构性不派发**：凡有子任务的卡（epic）永不进派发候选（与 `pipeline` 字段无关，不再只靠 `direct` 口头约定——手滑建 `full` 档 epic 也不会被派出占 worker 槽），子任务全了结转 verifying 后派 Verifier 验收不受影响
- **suggestSplit 软提示**：`task_create` / `create-task` 发现描述超 500 字符、或标题/描述命中「全量 / 整体 / 系统级 / 全面 / 重构 / 所有模块 / 整个」等史诗特征词时，返回体附带一行 `suggestSplit` 建议文案（**只提示，不阻断创建与派发**；未命中则不出现该字段，老调用方无感）
- **开关 `epicSplit`（史诗拆分总开关）**（⚙️ 入池配置弹层「**功能**」小节，默认**开**）：关掉只停**引导**——Team 提示词第 6~8 条拆分 doctrine 整条不注入、`create-task`/`task_create` 响应不再附 `suggestSplit` 软提示；**机制不禁**（显式传 `parentId` 建子卡、史诗自动收口与 hooks 状态机照常工作，明确要拆时不受阻）；老看板文件没有该字段 → 读路径自动补 `true`（与升级前行为一致）。工具描述里的粒度契约是静态工具定义（随 request header 快照），不在开关范围
- **模型字段写保护**：`set-board-config` 对 `workerModel`/`verifierModel` 的非空值校验当前网关可用清单（`list-models` 同款枚举）——手写非法 id（如把熔断通知里的显示名抄成 id）直接拒写并返回合法清单前 8 个，验收 spawn 不再 UNKNOWN_MODEL 秒死；空串=清除放行；宿主无 llm 服务时降级跳过校验不炸。配套熔断通知分态：`UNKNOWN_MODEL` 类失败报「配置非法（不在可用清单）」，与「验收连续失败」区分——mistake 归 mistake，quality 归 quality

### 一次性派发（v74 去池化）

- 每个任务 spawn 一个**一次性子代理**（Worker/Verifier），上下文全量注入 prompt，做完即销毁——无常驻池、无池化状态残留（Worker 的可续跑形态见上一节「可续跑 Worker」，Verifier 与 hook run 恒为一次性）
- **预研上下文注入（contextFiles/contextNotes，瘦身分离形态）**：主窗口调研时读过的文件与笔记随子代理的**首条 prompt 一次性注入**——调研笔记全文（notes，≤8000 字符）+ **文件清单**（每行「`路径:L起-L止` — 一句用途」）；**文件内容本体不进 prompt**，由子代理用 `read` 工具按行号范围按需自取（执行时盘面更新鲜；旧形态「host 读盘取正文注入」既受单文件 8KB/总包 40KB 截断，又随 runtime 快照每轮刷新重发——自治 run 实测 6×48.8K 字符≈白烧 75–100K token）；UI 侧调研门禁——full/work 且声明了 touches 却未附调研的卡片亮「⚠️ 无调研」徽章，详情页「调研注入」区列 files 清单 + notes 字数（无则明示）
  - **锚点行段与用途**：`contextFiles` 条目写法「`path:L2350-L2420` / `path:L2350`」+ 可选「` — 一句用途`」（em dash 两侧空格分隔；缺省只给路径行号）——锚点只认尾部 `:L<行号>`（兼容 Windows 盘符），清单里原样带上行号供子代理直接按行段 read；锚点写错（`:L0` / `:L5-L2`）自动剥掉，不误导子代理去读空段
  - **按需自取代替 host 预切段**：派发侧零读盘（不再切行段、不再附结构索引块）——子代理自己 `read(path, offset, limit)` 取需要的那段，清单里给出的行号就是起点；`task_preview_context` / `preview-context` 返回的也是这份瘦身清单（不是文件正文）
- **派发调研门禁（warning 族，软提示不阻断）**：`task_create`/`create-task` 响应附 `warning` 字段——①描述为空「Worker 只能凭标题猜需求」②full/work + touches 非空而未附调研上下文 ③touches 含整树 glob 建议精确到文件级（可多条合并）；GUI 表单内黄色展示不关窗。epic 发布（publish）时自动轻量预检全部子任务注入情况，缺材料则 pushSysNote 汇总提醒主窗口（全有不打扰）；派发时清单组装失败落任务「最近失败」行，不再静默。另存 `lintWarnings[]` 起草 lint（四规则：touches 整树 glob「粒度过粗，几乎锁整仓」/ 相对路径双仓库歧义「建议加仓库前缀」/ full 无验收「建议带验收命令」/ 标题缺动词或描述空），落卡透出、详情页 ⚠️ 行展示，不阻断创建
- **Worker/Verifier 均可配置异构模型**（⚙️ 弹出层下拉选择，空 = 继承父级），避免同源盲点；模型故障自动熔断回退父级模型

适用场景：用户用自然语言丢来一个大需求（跨模块、边界不清、一口气干不完）——先建 **draft 需求卡**保留需求原文，再用 `task_decompose` 派**一次性拆解官**出实现侧子卡提案；确认后逐张发布，Worker 拿到的就是 10~30 分钟可独立验收的小卡。Team 模式第 9 条需求卡工作流（`TEAM_DECOMPOSE_FLOW`）即这条链路；`task_decompose` 工具常驻，**不受 `epicSplit` 开关影响**。

- **幂等重拆**：新提案落地时清掉上次**未发布**的提案子卡（`proposalOf` 指向该源卡且仍 `draft` 的整批移除）；已 publish/已落定的子卡绝不碰；提案畸形或 run 失败时旧批**不清**（失败不毁已有资产），失败原因落源卡消息，可原样重试。

# @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow-ui — the SDLC web panel

The browser half of the orchestrator: an **SDLC** tab in the web app's right
sidebar, plus the host routes that feed it.

| Surface | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Flow | live animated DAG, attention queue, progress/state distribution, parallel-worker meter, gates/routing/activity, inline task detail |
| Tasks | searchable tasks grouped by lifecycle state, with Active/Blocked/Done filters and the same task detail |
| Review | select a task and two runs; signed deltas, changed gates, collapsed trace path |
| Settings (gear) | validated `.sdlc/config.yml` editor plus **Use this Harness model** adoption; only changed fields can be saved |

The **Live map** is a deterministic SVG derived in the browser from the flow
snapshot — no model call, no generated HTML. Stages are horizontal bands so
parallel work appears side by side; running nodes glow, active edges stream
dashed packets, completed paths stay lit, and blocked/failed paths turn red.
Hovering or selecting a task traces its upstream and downstream path. Reduced
motion drops the animation but keeps the state colours and labels; every node
is keyboard-focusable.

**Harness model adoption.** Settings shows the provider/model the current DSH
session resolves and a button that rewrites all three tiers to it. The host
plugin reads `agentDefaultModel` opportunistically (it is not a hard inject),
so an older profile still renders Settings without the card. Cost is recorded
as explicitly unknown when DSH exposes no currency metadata.

The old **Status** and **Board** tabs were removed: the flow snapshot already
carries project state, task totals, spend and every task, so those tabs were a
second render of the same data. Flow and Tasks share one snapshot. Polling is
2.5 s while a task or worker is in flight and 8 s when quiet; each poll sends
the newest event id as a cursor so only new events cross the wire and the client
merges them into a bounded window. Settings loads config only when opened. The
snapshot also carries the host-computed `totals.parallelism` (`configured`,
`effective`, `active`, `saturated`), so the meter shows real slots instead of a
guess from `auto`.

Host routes: `/api/sdlc.status`, `/api/sdlc.board`, `/api/sdlc.task`,
`/api/sdlc.compare`, `/api/sdlc.config` (GET + validated POST),
`/api/sdlc.host` (POST — adopt the Harness provider/model),
`/api/sdlc.metrics`, `/api/sdlc.flow` (bounded visualizer snapshot). The routes
remain part of the host contract; the sidebar itself now reads `flow`, `config`
and `compare`. Every row is scoped to the open session workspace: a project
row whose `repo_path` belongs to another checkout is ignored. A workspace with
no project is **auto-bootstrapped on the first request** with the Harness's
current provider/model as the tier route — no `sdlc init`, no API key; only a
workspace with no recognised stack marker gets a 404 `NO_PROJECT`, carrying the
actionable reason (the guided state).

The tab is registered as a right-sidebar page with a guide entry, so a new
session can open it from the guide's **SDLC Flow** capsule. With
`autoOpen: true` (the shipped default) it also opens once for the first session
that has an SDLC project; the snapshot is kept as *stale* when a poll fails.

`lib/client.js` is a prebuilt closure-factory bundle that registers into the
right-sidebar slot system; it needs no build step on the consumer's machine.

## Install

Installed into the interactive lead only — a `web`-platform profile. It is a
member of [`@patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile sdlc-web add @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow
```

It must never be mounted in the headless worker profile (E6).

## Requirements

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`
- Node.js ≥ 22.13
- a profile whose client platform is `web`

## License

MIT

# dsh-sdlc-flow — DSH SDLC Flow (DeepSeek Harness plugin suite)

> **Current release: 1.1.1.** Install from this checkout
> (`npm run install:local`), or the registry form
> (`npx -y @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow@latest dsh-sdlc-install`) — see
> [Install](#install). See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for scope and known
> limitations and [PROOF_REPORT.md](PROOF_REPORT.md) for measured evidence. No
> confirmatory developer-productivity claim is supported yet.

A DeepSeek Harness plugin suite that turns a requirement into a verified,
merged change: it plans a task DAG, dispatches role-preset workers into isolated
git worktrees, verifies against risk-appropriate gates, and integrates.

**Implemented from** [`universal_sdlc_orchestrator_dsh_spec_v3.md`](universal_sdlc_orchestrator_dsh_spec_v3.md).

| Document | What it is |
|---|---|
| [universal_sdlc_orchestrator_dsh_spec_v3.md](universal_sdlc_orchestrator_dsh_spec_v3.md) | the normative specification |
| [SDLC_V3_IMPLEMENTATION_VALIDATION_REPORT.md](SDLC_V3_IMPLEMENTATION_VALIDATION_REPORT.md) | gate results, test pyramid, defects found |
| [SDLC_IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md](SDLC_IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md) | deviations D0–D7, fixes, what is not implemented |
| [EVAL_PROTOCOL.md](EVAL_PROTOCOL.md) | pre-registered A/B design proving the plugin beats plain DSH |
| [IMPROVEMENT_AUDIT.md](IMPROVEMENT_AUDIT.md) | honest audit: what was fixed, measured, or deliberately left |

## Tool startup troubleshooting

The source checkout contains unreleased tool-lifecycle repairs; reinstalling
`@latest` does not fetch these changes until a new release is published. Desktop
users can install the rebuilt `packages/sdlc-orchestrator` directory through
**Plugins → Add plugin** using its absolute path, then quit Harness completely
and reopen it. Do not edit the Desktop profile by hand. Once this build is
installed, later registry releases are checked on startup: stable builds install
automatically, prerelease builds report availability (`SDLC_AUTO_UPDATE=install`
opts in; `off` disables). Restart to load the new code.

### “The panel is newer than the SDLC host code”

Host plugin code is loaded once at process start; an in-place update replaces
files on disk but not the host code already running. The panel now probes the
routes and distinguishes three cases before telling you what to do:

- **status answers, flow does not** — an older host build is loaded; fully quit
  Harness and reopen. Closing the window can leave it running in the background:
  use **Quit** from the app/tray menu, or on Linux
  `pkill -f deepseek-harness` / `flatpak kill com.deepseek.harness`.
- **no SDLC route answers** — the host plugin is not registered or enabled in
  this profile; enable it in **Plugins**, or install it for that profile.
- **the probe cannot reach the host** — a transport/connection problem, not a
  version mismatch.

For the **Desktop app**, update through **Plugins → Add plugin** and restart.
`npx -y @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow@latest dsh-sdlc-install` manages the
`sdlc-web` / `sdlc-worker` / `sdlc-probe` CLI profiles; it cannot modify the
app-owned `desktop` profile. The panel shows the panel/host builds and a
**Copy diagnostics** action for support.

The panel also reads the **open session's workspace**, not the Harness process
directory, so the Desktop app shows the project you are actually working in.

For an offline runtime check (no model and no second web server):

```sh
node scripts/verify-tool-runtime.mjs /path/to/unpacked/dsh-runtime
```

It mounts all 26 role compositions and checks tool visibility, real pipeline
execution/rendering, invalid arguments, and worker denial of lead capabilities.
It also asserts that the shipped lead exposes one selectable preset (the Lead
Orchestrator), not the whole role roster. OS/delegation boundaries are stubbed:
this does not test running workers or the Desktop session-creation UI. An
optional second argument points to an unpacked plugin tarball.
A `never started` diagnostic means the loader did not create a plugin fiber;
look for the **earlier loader import error** in the application log. A missing
service instead reports `waiting for tools`. If the former persists after a
clean restart/install, include that earlier error and the installed version.

## Quick start

```sh
npm run build                     # artifacts (zero dependencies, offline; incl. UI bundle)
node scripts/validate-gates.mjs   # gate:P → gate:Q  (no model, no network)
npm run test:unit                 # L2 — pure modules + property tests
```

Every `test:*` script passes explicit globs rather than a directory: Node 24
resolves a bare directory positional as a *script* and fails with
`Cannot find module '<dir>'`, while globs work on every supported engine.

The deterministic control plane needs no model at all:

```sh
node packages/sdlc-cli/bin/sdlc.mjs init        # .sdlc/, integration branch, detected gates
node packages/sdlc-cli/bin/sdlc.mjs status
node packages/sdlc-cli/bin/sdlc.mjs selftest --mock
```

## Flow visualizer (right sidebar)

While a session is open, the DSH right sidebar contains an **SDLC Flow** entry
(the guide's capsule, or auto-open on the first session that has an SDLC
project). It is a live, read-only view of the orchestrator, built around one
question: **what needs attention?** The old Status and Board tabs were duplicates
of data already in the flow snapshot, so the panel now has three primary
surfaces plus settings:

- **Flow** — a live **animated task map** (below) plus a “Needs attention” queue
  first (unresolved escalations, failed tasks, failing gates, orphaned worker
  runs, path conflicts), a progress ring and state distribution, live workers,
  and collapsible gates/routing/activity evidence. Click a task node to open its
  detail: role, risk, tier/model, attempts, resources, runs, gates, dependencies
  and the latest event, plus **Compare runs**.
- **Live map** — a deterministic SVG rendered in the browser from the flow
  snapshot (no model call, no generated diagram). Stages are horizontal bands, so
  parallel branches appear side by side; running nodes glow and stream packets
  along their dependency edges, completed paths stay lit, and blocked or failed
  paths turn red. Hover or select a node to trace its upstream and downstream
  path. The parallel meter shows active workers against the host-computed
  effective cap, and the progress card shows recorded tokens per completed task.
- **Tasks** — the board without columns: search, All/Active/Blocked/Done
  filters, tasks grouped by lifecycle state, and the same inline task detail.
- **Review** — task and run **selects** populated from the flow snapshot (no
  hand-typed IDs); defaults to the newest two runs, shows signed time/token/cost
  deltas, changed gates, and a collapsed trace path.
- **Settings** (gear) — a validated `.sdlc/config.yml` editor grouped by section.
  Only changed fields get a Save button; rejected writes never touch the file.

All surfaces share one `/api/sdlc.flow` snapshot and one config snapshot. Polling
is adaptive — 2.5 s while a task or worker is in flight, 8 s when quiet — and
each poll sends the newest event id as a cursor, so only new events cross the
wire and the client merges them into a bounded window. On a failed poll the last
snapshot is shown as *stale* rather than blanked. Opening the panel on a
workspace that has never been initialised **bootstraps it automatically** (see
[No init step — use the Harness model](#no-init-step--use-the-harness-model));
the guided state now appears only when auto-setup genuinely fails (no recognised
stack marker), with the real reason and a copyable `sdlc init` command that
prints the same diagnosis. A bare 404 is diagnosed as a host/client version
mismatch with restart and reinstall guidance (an in-place update does not
replace loaded host code). Missing cost/tokens/duration stay `—` with a reason,
never `0`. Set `autoOpen: false` in the UI row config to stop the automatic
open. DSH's right sidebar has **no surface without a session**, so the Start
screen cannot show it — start a session first.

## Install

### One command — always the latest published version

```sh
npx -y @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow@latest dsh-sdlc-install
```

This resolves `latest` from the npm registry itself, pins the **exact** version
in the `sdlc-web` profile, records the matching pnpm release-age exemption,
creates the profile when missing, prunes packages left by older releases,
installs, re-selects the bundle (a failed uninstall can leave the package
installed but disabled), and verifies the installed `package.json`. Re-running
it upgrades an existing install instead of requiring an uninstall first.

```sh
npx -y @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow@latest dsh-sdlc-install --only all          # lead + worker + probe
npx -y @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow@latest dsh-sdlc-install --tag beta          # newest prerelease
npx -y @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow@latest dsh-sdlc-install --version 1.1.1
npx -y @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow@latest dsh-sdlc-install --check --json      # no changes
```

It is idempotent. Prerequisites: `dsh` and `pnpm` on `PATH`, Node ≥ 22.13.

> **Restart after installing.** A running lead keeps the old module tree in
> memory even after the package on disk changes (deep-imported preset rows are
> not hot-replaced). Quit DeepSeek Harness completely and reopen it; otherwise a
> new session can still report the previous version's `agent-preset/invalid`.
> The installer prints this reminder.

### No-clone install — prebuilt release artifact

Download the release artifact and run its installer. Nothing is compiled on your
machine, and you do not need the source.

```sh
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/pwoodman/dsh-sdlc/releases/latest/download/dsh-sdlc-beta.tgz
tar xzf dsh-sdlc-beta.tgz && cd dsh-sdlc-*/
./install.sh
```

`install.sh` copies the plugin tree to `$DSH_HOME/dsh-sdlc/<version>/` (so you can
delete the download), then creates the `sdlc-web`, `sdlc-worker` and `sdlc-probe`
profiles, installs the bundles, verifies the composed lead and runs `gate:M0`. It
is idempotent — re-run it any time.

Prerequisites: `dsh` **installed as a package** (`npm install -g
@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2`), `pnpm` on `PATH`, Node ≥ 22.13. A wrapper that
merely answers `dsh --version` — an `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` shim, a shell
function, a hand-written script — is not enough: the platform gate reads the
installed package's own files, and the installer now refuses that setup with
this reason instead of failing later inside `gate:M0`.

```sh
dsh --profile sdlc-web          # the interactive lead (web GUI)
```

### Uninstall — one click in the plugin manager

The lead installs exactly **one** package (`@patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow`; its
members are folded inside it), so removing that single entry in the plugin
manager removes everything — no ghost entries, nothing "still required". From
the CLI it is the same one spec:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile sdlc-web remove @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow
```

A profile installed by a pre-fold release may still list the four members as
plain dependencies; re-run the installer (or this one command) to clear them:

```sh
pnpm remove --dir ~/.dsh/profiles/sdlc-web \
  @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow-core @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow-tools \
  @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow-presets @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow-ui
```

On Windows, close a running lead first (`sdlc.db` and the bundle files are held
open while it runs). A profile directory itself (`~/.dsh/profiles/sdlc-web`) is
disposable and can always be deleted outright. The `@deepseek-ai/…` bundles you
see running (for example `dsh-agent-preset-registry`) are DeepSeek Harness's
own — they ship with the profile template and are not part of this plugin.

### DeepSeek Harness Desktop — what works today

The Desktop app owns its `desktop` profile and the `dsh` CLI refuses to manage
it, so the CLI/tarball paths above do not target it. Desktop users install
through the sidebar **Plugins → Add plugin** dialog (paste a package name, a
tarball URL, or an absolute path).

Two honest limits on a Desktop-only machine:

- the lead dispatches workers by spawning `dsh --profile sdlc-worker`, so it
  needs a `dsh` CLI on `PATH` for real task execution — without one, the lead,
  the tools, the presets and the web panel all work, but dispatch does not;
- package installs into `desktop` are the app's own operation, so a plugin that
  needs the worker/probe profiles is better tested against CLI profiles.

### Registry / Add-plugin wizard — one spec for the lead

Once the packages are published under an npm scope you own, the lead is a single
spec (the same shape `dsh-context` and `dsh-proactive` use: prebuilt `lib/` + its
own `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the loader mounts it with no profile edits, no build
and no restart):

```sh
dsh --profile sdlc-web --from-default-profile web --dump-config   # create once
dsh plugin --profile sdlc-web add @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow              # core + tools + presets + ui
dsh --profile sdlc-web
```

Or fill `@patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow` into the **Add plugin** wizard on the Plugins page.

> **Fresh release not installing?** pnpm 11 applies a 24-hour
> `minimumReleaseAge` to range and `latest` installs, so a release published in
> the last day can resolve to the *previous* version. Prefer the installer
> above; it pins the exact version and writes the exemption for you. For a
> manual install, pin it exactly
> (`@patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow@1.1.1`) and add **one list item per pattern** to
> the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:
>
> ```yaml
> minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
>   - '@patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow@1.1.1'
> ```
>
> A combined value such as `pkg@a || pkg@b` is not a valid pnpm pattern (it is
> ignored, silently reintroducing the old resolution). The same applies to the
> worker members.

The worker profile is deliberately *unpacked*, because mounting the host services
there would start a second scheduler and a second writer against `sdlc.db`
(errata E6):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile sdlc-worker add @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow-guard @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow-tools
```

`@patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow`'s patch layer is generated from its four members
(`node scripts/gen-bundle-patch.mjs`) — the DSH loader mounts only the bundles a
profile lists and never descends into a bundle's `dependencies`. In the lead the
members are ordinary module dependencies; adding them as bundles *as well*
composes every row twice.

#### Publishing under your own npm scope

The packages ship as `@patwoodman/*`. If your npm account does not own that scope,
`npm publish` answers **403** and nobody can resolve `@patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow`. Fix it
in one command:

```sh
node scripts/set-scope.mjs @your-npm-username   # rewrites packages, patches, profiles, tests, docs
node scripts/set-scope.mjs @your-npm-username --check   # CI-safe drift check
```

An npm **user scope** (`@your-username`) is free and exists automatically once
you sign in to npm — `npm login` (GitHub OAuth works) or `npm adduser`. A free npm
**org** (`@acme-team`) works too: <https://www.npmjs.com/org/create>. Then:

```sh
git tag v1.1.1 && git push origin v1.1.1
```

The **Release** workflow verifies the tree, builds the tarball, publishes the
GitHub Release, and — when the repo has an `NPM_TOKEN` secret *and* the
`PUBLISH_NPM` variable is `true` — publishes the packages in dependency order.
Create the token at <https://www.npmjs.com/settings/~/tokens> (an *Automation*
token, so 2FA does not block CI) and add it as a repository secret.

### From a source checkout — one command

```sh
npm run install:local     # = node scripts/install-local.mjs
node scripts/doctor.mjs   # expect PASS
```

That single command generates the patches, builds the artifacts (zero
dependencies, offline), creates the three profiles from their shipped templates,
installs the bundles, verifies the composed lead and runs `gate:M0`. It is
idempotent and safe to re-run.

Prerequisites: `dsh` installed as a package (`npm install -g
@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2`), `pnpm` on `PATH`, Node ≥ 22.13, a POSIX host with
git.

### Building a release artifact

```sh
node scripts/build-release.mjs        # → dist/dsh-sdlc-<version>.tgz + dsh-sdlc-beta.tgz
```

### Update / upgrade

Re-running the installer is the upgrade path — it resolves the newest published
version, prunes packages left by older releases, and replaces the installed
meta-bundle:

```sh
npx -y @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow@latest dsh-sdlc-install
npx -y @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow@latest dsh-sdlc-install --only all
npx -y @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow@latest dsh-sdlc-install --check --json
```

The lead also checks the registry on startup (at most once per 24 hours).
Stable builds install a newer version through DSH's plugin manager; prerelease
builds only report availability by default (`SDLC_AUTO_UPDATE=install` opts in).
The running process keeps the old code until it is restarted; the update reports
`restart-required`. A failed install is retried after a short backoff, the
installed version is verified on disk, and a major release requires explicit
consent. Disable the check with `SDLC_AUTO_UPDATE=off`. Link, file, git and
source-checkout installs are never replaced automatically.

### Uninstall

Remove the package and its bundle selection from every managed profile:

```sh
npx -y @patwoodman/dsh-sdlc-flow@latest dsh-sdlc-install --uninstall --only all
```

The GUI path is unchanged: the lead profile contains exactly one own-scope
package, so **Plugins → Remove** removes everything. Profile directories are
left in place; delete them only if you also want to discard their config.

## Layout

```
packages/sdlc-core/      host services + pure domain modules (never in a worker)
packages/sdlc-guard/     worker-side policy (tools/pre-execute, fs deciders)
packages/sdlc-tools/     propose-only model tools + the /sdlc command surface
packages/sdlc-presets/   26 dsh-agent-preset rows (generated from roles.js)
packages/sdlc-cli/       the `sdlc` executable
packages/sdlc-mock-llm/  deterministic ctx.llm provider (test-only)
packages/sdlc-client-ui/ web UI: live flow map, tasks, review, validated config (sdlc-web only)
profiles/                installer recipes: sdlc-web, sdlc-worker, sdlc-probe
scripts/                 gates (P, M0–M8, Q), build, installer, doctor, harness
tests/                   unit · contract · integration · fault · adversarial · e2e
```

## Modes (spec C.2)

| Mode | Command | Slash commands | Approvals | Instance lock |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Interactive lead | `dsh --profile sdlc-web` | yes | yes | yes |
| Headless one-shot | `dsh --profile sdlc-worker "<task>"` | no | no (fail-closed) | no |
| Deterministic CLI | `sdlc status/tasks/…` | n/a | read/ops only | briefly |
| Boot probe | `dsh --profile sdlc-probe` | no | no | briefly |

Only the interactive lead can grant authority. A headless deployment is a guest
of the state machine: it can run work but cannot unblock itself.

## Web UI

`dsh --profile sdlc-web` mounts the **SDLC** right-sidebar tab (package
`sdlc-client-ui`, `sdlc-web` only):

| Panel | What it does |
|---|---|
| Flow | live animated task map, attention queue, parallel-worker meter, progress/spend, task detail |
| Tasks | search, All/Active/Blocked/Done filters, lifecycle grouping, inline task detail |
| Review | side-by-side time/tokens/tracepaths for two runs of one task |
| Settings | validated editor for `.sdlc/config.yml` (tiers, budgets, gates — writes rejected when validation fails) |

Host routes (`/api/sdlc.status`, `/api/sdlc.board`, `/api/sdlc.task`,
`/api/sdlc.compare`, `/api/sdlc.config`, `/api/sdlc.metrics`,
`/api/sdlc.flow`) read the live DB and are scoped to the open session's
workspace; the one POST validates through the same `validateConfig` the CLI
uses. A project row belonging to another checkout is never rendered.
The browser bundle is built offline by `node scripts/build-ui.mjs` (part of
`npm run build`) with zero dependencies.

### No init step — use the Harness model

Two rituals are gone: there is **no `sdlc init` step** and **no provider API
key**. DeepSeek Harness already resolves the signed-in provider/account (for
example `deepseek-account/deepseek-flash`) and its credential, and the
orchestrator now inherits both.

**Bootstrap on first touch.** The first panel request against a workspace root
materialises `.sdlc/` (tree, DB, gate detection, integration branch) and writes
a `config.yml` whose three tiers all name the model the current Harness session
resolves — the live `agentDefaultModel` selection, then on-disk profile
discovery, then DSH's own base default. `sdlc status` and
`sdlc config use-host-model` do the same from the CLI, so no command sequence
is required at all. The guarantees:

- **No key is ever implied.** A bootstrapped config names exactly one provider
  in its tiers and its price table — the fresh user is never asked for a
  second credential. `--no-host-model` (on `sdlc init`) opts out for
  deployments that route models some other way — read commands never write
  the spec defaults; exactly one of `--provider`/`--model` is a usage error,
  never a silent fallback.
- **Authored configs are never rewritten by a read.** Bootstrap only writes a
  config that does not exist yet. Changing the route later is an explicit
  action: **Settings → Harness model → Use this model for all tiers**, or
  `sdlc config use-host-model` (add `--provider`/`--model` to override, or
  `--dsh-home`/`--profile` outside the app). Both validate before writing,
  keep your own price rows without re-introducing legacy ones, and bootstrap
  an uninitialised workspace in one shot.
- **Half-projects heal themselves.** "Complete" means config.yml AND the
  database, and `ensureProject` is the single authority on it. An early
  `sdlc tasks` opens the DB before any config exists; a `git clean -fdx`
  removes the gitignored DB and keeps the config — the next touch repairs
  the missing half without touching the authored one.
- **No workspace is a dead end.** A workspace without a recognised stack
  marker (a plain folder, a Node project with only `package.json`, a
  `requirements.txt` Python project) still bootstraps — with
  `verification.detection: manual` and empty gates, the artifact the spec's
  own failure message prescribes. `sdlc config validate` visibly warns that
  verification passes vacuously until gates are authored, and the explicit
  `sdlc init` still refuses to guess. npm detection matches the spec's F.5
  table: `package-lock.json` is the npm marker — a bare `package.json` no
  longer produces `npm ci` commands that can never run.
- **Failure is actionable, never a mutation.** When auto-setup genuinely
  fails (an unwritable workspace, an unexpected error), the panel explains
  why with the host's real reason, the CLI prints a clean
  `BOOTSTRAP_FAILED` report, and nothing is guessed. A failed explicit init
  leaves the user's git repository untouched (no integration branch, no
  .gitignore); auto-setup never writes a `.gitignore` outside a git
  repository. A leftover tree cannot be poisoned: config writes and
  adoption require a complete project. The next request retries, so fixing
  the workspace recovers without a host restart.
- **"No project yet" is not a failure.** A set-up workspace with no project
  row shows an accurate empty state — "create a project with `/sdlc run`" —
  not a setup-failure card.

**Workers use the same route and the same credential store.** In-process
subagents already run on the parent route, so delegation needs no key of its
own. Process workers receive the adopted provider/model through the
`agent-default-model` tier overlay and `DSH_HOME`, so `deepseek-account`
resolves the same account token. No provider key is ever materialized into the
worker environment.

When DSH exposes no currency metadata, the adopted price entry is explicitly
`unknown`; cost renders as `—` instead of a guessed number. Configure prices in
Settings if you want cost estimates.

## Status

`gate:P` and `gate:M0`…`gate:M8` plus `gate:Q` pass (11/11); 906 offline tests
pass across unit/contract/integration/fault/adversarial, 9/10 e2e (1 skipped
by design), 86/86 eval harness. The 1.1.1 packed tarballs install, boot the
probe, create a lead session and uninstall cleanly; the no-clone tarball also
installs end-to-end in a fresh `DSH_HOME` and passes M0. `doctor` passes with 0
errors and 0 warnings on a configured host. See the validation report §1 for the two
environment-dependent skips (pnpm-present vs absent, Playwright stack).
